item.title: Yggdrasil: Tree-Routed Recurrent Experts for State Tracking and Fast CPU Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Mamba、线性注意力、DeltaNet 等可并行训练循环提供常数开销流式推理，但难跟踪离散状态，且每步读全部参数，模型容量直接绑定 CPU 延迟。

方法：Yggdrasil 树路由循环专家：每层在大规模树路由专家库中查转移，用当前 token 与下层状态寻址；证明跨层上下文必要（单 token 索引、有限可达状态的非扩张转移层无法做条件重置）；每步走一条树路径、每层读单个专家，活跃权重仅几百 KB 留在 CPU L2，全库驻留 RAM。

关键数字：评估的并行可训练模型中唯一解全部 5 个状态跟踪任务；匹配活跃参数下 enwik8 最低 1.540 bpb、人类基因组 hg38 1.567 bpb；单 CPU 核 6.7μs/5.8μs 步进，比最快流式基线快 3.0x/3.3x；batch 1024 GPU 吞吐最高；Genomic Benchmarks 匹配活跃参数下最强因果模型（平均准确率 86.0%）。

为什么值得看：容量与每步计算解耦 + 离散状态跟踪，CPU 流式推理新范式。

item.title: X-BQSR: Holistic Acceleration of Base Quality Recalibration for Scalable Genomic Analysis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：GATK 变异检测流水线中最贵步骤之一——碱基质量重校准（BQSR）在 GPU 上未被系统探索；简单卸载关键阶段不足以获得整体收益。

方法：X-BQSR 全流水线重构（I/O、压缩、kernel 执行）以更好利用 GPU 并行；SYCL 可移植 kernel 支持 NVIDIA/AMD/Intel GPU，另有原生 CUDA/HIP 后端对比；对照先前 FPGA 工作评估。

关键数字：较标准 GATK 最高 141.7x 加速、较专有 GPU 加速方案 8.7x。

为什么值得看：基因组学 BQSR 的 GPU 全栈加速，跨厂商可移植。

item.title: Which $\Diamond \mathcal{P}$ Algorithm is Suitable for You? An Empirical Benchmark on Real Network Traces
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Unreliable failure detectors (UFDs) are a fundamental abstraction for dependability and fault tolerance in distributed systems, supporting core distributed algorithms, such as consensus. Yet selecting a suitable detector remains difficult because existing implementations are evaluated under different environments, workloads, parameterizations, and quality-of-service (QoS) requirements. We address this problem by systematizing 14 $\Diamond \mathcal{P}$ and closely related $\Diamond \mathcal{P}$-style UFDs, implementing 13 of them, and providing a reusable benchmark for their empirical comparison. Our methodology evaluates detectors through common QoS metrics, such as detection time, mistake rate, and query accuracy, and combines same-input replay of network traces with live deployment for detectors whose active probing or cooperative behavior requires online execution. We then formalize failure-detector selection as a constrained algorithm-selection challenge, mapping operational requirements to suitable detector candidates. We instantiate this methodology under controlled variations of communication rate, host load, and crash regime. Applying the selection process shows that no det…

item.title: What Information Survives Authenticated Byzantine Communication?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Two principals independently approve actions for a delegate that can choose a route to a goal and carry it out under current policy. A stable work-order receipt records the routes authorized at issuance. For intersection policies, we characterize the leading number of reachable joint configurations under overlapping updates. The lower bound uses the first writer's ability to finish before its peer invokes an update. The matching protocol checks an older route against the changed principal's policy because the unchanged principal already approved each of its steps. When each route has a command unique to it, the count has a closed form in terms of unions of route supports. Two three-command workflows with four possible receipts each have leading counts of $360$ and $328$ under encoded overwrite, and both have append count $1024$. Exact policy read-back forces at least six bits per block in both cases. Route overlap affects the count even when route lengths are fixed. The construction preserves authorization, withdrawal, stable recovery, and progress after stabilization with one coordinator crash.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: What Field Enumeration Costs to Compile in C++26: Native Reflection, Structured-Binding Packs, Reflection Libraries and Hand-Written Serializers on GCC 16
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

C++26 adds standard ways to enumerate a struct's fields, among them static reflection (P2996, with P3394 annotations) and structured-binding packs (P1061), alongside hand-written code, X-macros and libraries (Boost.PFR, reflect-cpp, Glaze) that now ship pre-C++26 and C++26 paths. We time each in a struct serializer with byte-identical output on GCC 16.2.0, at the front end and at -O2, in randomized interleaved rounds with code-level checks of every single-factor contrast. At the front end, inline native enumeration in the form used in several of P2996's own examples, an expansion statement over the std::span of define_static_array, costs about as much per struct of 16 scalar fields as Boost.PFR and 7.96x a P1061 pack, itself about as cheap as hand-written code. The same loop over a constant array costs 0.47x as much: about half of the span form's cost comes with the span. The ratio to P1061 shrinks on a heterogeneous type graph and at -O2. In a whole translation unit at the front end the library outweighs the mechanism: 200 structs take 0.59 s with inline native enumeration, 0.56 s with Boost.PFR and 3.86-4.13 s with the C++26 paths of reflect-cpp and Glaze, whose visitors also com…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: What Environment Invariance Identifies: Minimal Invariant Sets in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Invariant causal prediction identifies the direct causes of a target $Y$ by searching for covariate sets whose conditional law of $Y$ is stable across environments. We state that criterion at the level of operators, calling a set $S$ invariant when the conditional mean embeddings of $Y$ given $X_S$ agree across environments, and characterise the resulting family exactly: under two conditions on the environments, which we state separately because they fail independently, the invariant sets are precisely those containing $PA(Y)$ and no descendant of $Y$. Two consequences follow. Invariance does not identify $PA(Y)$ uniquely, since every descendant-free superset is invariant as well; and $PA(Y)$ is the unique minimal invariant set. In finite samples, recovery requires the non-invariant sets to be separated from invariance by a margin, and the sample size splits into a screening term logarithmic in the ambient dimension and a term inherited from conditional mean embedding estimation, which is the binding one. The characterisation yields two selection rules with different failure modes, of which the conservative one controls false positives. Controlled experiments verify each population…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Verifiable On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful approach for improving language-model reasoning, but its supervision is inherently sparse: a sequence-level verifier reward is propagated only through sampled trajectories and provides no direct signal for alternative actions. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a complementary form of supervision by providing dense teacher feedback over the full next-token distribution, but this signal is not grounded in verified task outcomes. Simply co-optimizing the two objectives does not couple these signals: verifier feedback remains sparse and does not inform the dense teacher supervision. We introduce Verifiable On-Policy Distillation (VOPD), which transfers sparse verifier feedback into dense, verifier-grounded supervision. Our key observation is that the implicit-reward view of OPD places teacher supervision and verifier feedback in a common reward space while retaining a reward signal available for every next-token action. Under this view, VOPD projects verifier preference onto the teacher's implicit-reward direction and Rao--Blackwellizes the resulting signal over the full vocabulary, propagating verifier-groun…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Verifiable Logical-Physical Contracts for Refactored On-Die Power Control Circuitry
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Recent literature allows independent hardware experiments to occupy a single die for scalable and cost-efficient silicon prototyping. Within this framework, specialized hardware functions including low-power control mechanisms can be offered as reusable on-die microservices. However, this requires well-defined contracts connecting digital requests to physical behavior. We present a checkable logical-physical contract formulation including a physical contract model describing service completion between client and provider through formally verified digital guarantees and physically validated completion conditions. We introduce Lightswitch, a proof-of-concept on-die power control microservice. We assess post-layout designs in TSMC 28nm and demonstrate how checkable contracts provide formal guarantees.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Vasicek Diffusion Bridge for Graph Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion-based graph generation models progressively transform Gaussian noise into structured graphs through stochastic dynamics. We observe that the effectiveness of this transformation is fundamentally determined by the evolution of the diffusion trajectory. Existing graph diffusion models often suffer from excessive uncertainty during diffusion and delayed growth of the signal-to-noise ratio, causing useful structural information to emerge only in the later stages of generation. To address this issue, we propose the Vasicek Graph Diffusion (VGD), a graph diffusion process derived from the Vasicek dynamics. The key insight of VGD is data-anchored mean dynamics with a closed-form solution, which analytically establishes a continuous transition from Gaussian noise to the target graph distribution. Unlike conventional graph diffusion processes that rely predominantly on stochastic evolution, VGD introduces a data-anchored drift that continuously steers the latent state toward the target distribution throughout diffusion. As a consequence, VGD maintains a smoothly evolving uncertainty while rapidly increasing the signal-to-noise ratio throughout diffusion, allowing informative graph…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Uncovering the Tells: Efficient Black-Box Audits for LLM Data Contamination
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Existing methods for assessing training data contamination in Large Language Models achieve high accuracy, but fundamentally rely on gray-box access, rendering them inapplicable to fully black-box environments. This limitation forces auditors to rely on full-sequence sampling or rigid heuristics, both of which incur prohibitive inference costs and struggle to isolate the underlying memorization signal. To overcome this, we propose a generation-based black-box framework that infers context-induced information gain from targeted token discrepancies. We introduce a budget-constrained auditing regime, building on the empirical observation that the membership signal is highly sparse and concentrated in a few highly informative tokens. We formalize this sparsity, showing why uniform sampling needs many more samples than a policy that targets informative positions. Empirically, our approach achieves state-of-the-art black-box separation accuracy while needing about 3x fewer queries than uniform position sampling. Finally, we apply this methodology to closed frontier models, exploring its capacity and limits in surfacing potential training data overlaps on commercial APIs.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Tracing Attacker Diversity Reduction in Adaptive LLM Red Teaming
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning can increase the success of automated red teaming but it also narrows the attack vector. This study asks where in the attacker-defender-judge learning loop does the narrowing begin and which mechanisms lead to a narrowing attack. Six mechanisms (defender adaptation, success edge, reward reinforcement, row cap, update size, and measurement) are tested across three experiment arms (co-trained, frozen defender, half learning rate) for twenty-four iterations. A frozen defender narrows attack diversity retention (ADR) earlier 0.496 relative to co-trained 0.891 at iteration twelve. Defender updates delay narrowing but dont prevent it. Successful attacks ("winners") have narrower attack diversity than the full set of generated attacks. Attacks closest to previous winners succeed 10-15 percentage points more often than those closest to previous failures. This winner-neighbor advantage holds after a defender update and for a fixed defender too. Attacks with a common opening have a common-opening advantage of 5-16 percentage points. The training row cap and update size account for little impact on ADR, and attack length accounts for only part of the ADR decrease. Narro…

item.title: Toward a Theoretical Understanding of Transformer Attention: Bayesian Estimation and Predictive Sufficiency
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

This paper develops a theoretical account of Transformer attention by organizing existing probabilistic and information-theoretic results. It identifies the assumptions under which attention computes a posterior mean and the additional conditions required for accurate next-token prediction. Posterior-mean optimality under squared-error loss does not by itself establish predictive sufficiency; even a sufficient representation requires a prediction head that uses its information correctly. An excess-log-loss decomposition makes this distinction precise by separating representation information loss from prediction-head error. The analysis clarifies the conditions required for predictive guarantees. Determining when these conditions hold in trained models, and how architectural or training choices can support them, could guide the development of AI systems that preserve and use predictive information more effectively.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Torcalia.jl: An MPI-based Runtime System for Asynchronous Task Parallelism in Julia
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Designed to address the two-language problem, the Julia programming language provides a powerful platform for developing high-performance scientific computing and machine learning applications. Such applications increasingly exhibit irregular, adaptive, or data-driven workloads for which traditional bulk-synchronous parallel (BSP) models often struggle to efficiently exploit the available parallelism. Asynchronous many-task (AMT) runtime systems offer a compelling alternative, decomposing computations into fine-grained tasks that are dynamically scheduled across the hierarchical architecture of modern HPC systems. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：边缘部署时间序列基础模型（TSFM）需随新观测刷新预测，且要求延迟/峰值内存随流增长有界、历史积累时保持精度；增量刷新不改变预测要求时序因果。

方法：让每种因果架构的状态跨刷新持久化，并验证与全重算等价；评估 9 种 TSFM 配置（单变量预测）对三项要求逐项测量（精度随上下文变化、单次刷新延迟、百万步流上的延迟与内存）。

关键数字：无模型在训练上下文之外有平均精度增益，多数在达全历史前已损失；KV 缓存延迟与内存随保留历史线性增长；TiRex-2 是 9 配置中唯一全部满足：GPU 刷新 14ms、树莓派 5 上 120ms，百万步内延迟/能耗/峰值内存恒定，未截断历史上保持精度。

为什么值得看：边缘时序基础模型的落地筛选，唯一全满足者可即用。

item.title: Synapse: An HBM-Coordinated HBF Near-Memory Computing Architecture for Pipelined Agentic AI Execution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：多 agent 视频推理中模型权重与每 agent KV 缓存可超 HBM 容量；高带宽闪存（HBF）增加容量，但 agent 仍等待 GPU 执行。

方法：Synapse，HBM 协调的近存计算架构：跨 agent 把 HBF 注意力与专家执行和 GPU 计算重叠；减少派发延迟与不必要刷新。

关键数字：三模型下端到端延迟降 48.92-66.60%、吞吐最高 2.98x、每输出 token 建模能耗最多降 64.48%（对比被动 HBF GPU 执行）；磨损仿真显示比整块刷新 HBF 寿命长 46%。

为什么值得看：HBF 近存计算 + 流水化 agentic AI 执行，容量-延迟-能耗三重收益。

item.title: STMemoLLM: A Spatial-Temporal Memory-Augmented LLM for Robust Traffic Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Traffic forecasting is essential for intelligent transportation systems. However, traditional deep-learning models often rely heavily on high-quality observations. Recent LLM-based approaches incorporate pretrained knowledge to improve forecasting, but they remain sensitive to input perturbations and struggle to preserve long-term patterns. To address this, we propose STMemoLLM, a spatial-temporal memory-augmented LLM for robust traffic forecasting. STMemoLLM introduces memory prototypes to compress inputs into compact summary tokens while extracting reliable dynamics from residual signals, achieving a balance between stability and variability. Specifically, a memory-enhanced tokenizer encodes prototypes and sensor characteristics into attention biases to guide adaptive compression of correlated sensors into semantic summary tokens. A memory-calibrated router further evaluates contextual deviation, compression deficiency, and prototype alignment to identify reliable residual signals, which complement the summaries while suppressing noise. Extensive experiments on eight real-world datasets show that STMemoLLM achieves state-of-the-art performance. Additional experiments examine poin…

item.title: RoFE: Rotated Frozen Embeddings for Low-Data Multimodal Tabular Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal tabular learning combines tabular data with images and text, often in settings where labeled data are scarce. Tabular foundation models such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) offer a promising solution via in-context learning without task-specific training. However, modern image and text encoders produce embeddings with hundreds or thousands of dimensions, far exceeding the number of features encountered during PFN pretraining. Existing approaches bridge this gap using principal component analysis (PCA) to compress frozen embeddings. Surprisingly, we find that this PCA interface can underperform simple linear classifiers when labeled examples are scarce, even though PFNs are designed for small datasets. We identify the underlying failure mechanism: the PFN's per-column standardization removes the variances of the PCA scores. When the PCA keeps every direction of the labeled examples, the examples collapse into a regular simplex in which all pairwise distances are equal. To address this problem, we propose Rotated Frozen Embeddings (RoFE), a training-free method that rotates PCA scores before PFN inference. We theoretically show that rotation makes the column variances…

item.title: Rewirable Circuits in Transformers with Loom Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Transformer 能否在每个 token 动态重连自身电路？

方法：loom attention 把 head 对更早 head 输出的垂直注意力（获得 Q/K/V）与其对 token 的水平注意力交织，实现逐 token 动态重连；垂直注意力用归一化+门控线性注意力在每 token 矩阵记忆上高效实例化，形成双流架构 LoomFormer（向量流管控制、矩阵流管内容）。

关键数字：多规模与训练预算下匹配 3x+ 算力训练的 Transformer 与 ~1.7-2.8x 算力的残差流基线（HC/mHC、MUDDFormer、AttnRes）；同一 300B token、仅 2% 额外 FLOPs 下 LoomPythia-2.8B 平均下游增益约为 mHC-Pythia-2.8B 相对 Pythia-2.8B 的 1.6x，0-shot 匹配/5-shot 超越 Pythia-12B；代码开源。

为什么值得看：双流记忆架构 + 动态电路重连，用约 2% 额外算力换显著下游增益。

item.title: Revisiting Continual Learning in Language Models: A Three-Interface Diagnosis of Stability and Plasticity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Continual learning in language models is commonly studied in the incremental learning (IL) setting, where a model learns a sequence of tasks and is evaluated through its final classifier or language-model (LM) head. This interface, however, does not indicate where forgetting occurs: a drop in accuracy may reflect representation degradation in the backbone, readout mismatch in the head, or both. We therefore argue that backward transfer (BWT) and forward transfer (FWT) should be interpreted as interface-dependent quantities rather than as single modellevel properties. We study three evaluation interfaces: the trained head, which is updated sequentially with the backbone; a probe newly trained on frozen backbone features; and a classifier-free backbone diagnostic. They measure deployed performance, recoverability under a new readout, and representation separability, respectively. Across class-incremental experiments with encoder and decoder language backbones, plus task-incremental sanity checks, conclusions about forgetting and plasticity change with the interface: the trained head often indicates severe forgetting, the probe near-complete recoverability, and the backbone diagnostic…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

方法：Dubot 自动调度框架：识别并发机会，提出三种共置机制（空间分区、块级共置、块内融合）；共置优化器在负载依赖、QoS 要求与硬件资源约束下求最优调度方案。

为什么值得看：移动 GPU 上 VLA+MPC 共置调度的系统化方案，机器人/边缘具身场景直接受益。

item.title: Reinforcing Diffusion Models by Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Forward diffusion reinforcement learning (RL)---enabling deterministic ODE sampling without trajectory backpropagation---has grown increasingly popular for efficiently aligning diffusion models. However, we reveal that existing methods essentially rely on signed reward-weighted regression (RWR), regressing the \emph{trainable policy} velocity onto rollouts from a \emph{behavior distribution}. Unbiased baseline subtraction implicitly assumes that the policy velocity equals the behavior marginal velocity---an idealized assumption violated under classifier-free guidance (CFG) rollouts, offline/off-policy updates, and imperfect online self-consistency. This \emph{behavior--policy mismatch} breaks baseline invariance and injects \emph{baseline-induced gradient drift}, destabilizing training. To resolve this issue, we propose \textbf{I}nstantaneous \textbf{T}rajectory \textbf{D}istribution \textbf{M}atching (\textbf{iTDM}), taking the infinitesimal limit of Trajectory Distribution Matching toward a time-local reward-guided target via the posterior-score identity to yield a sample-level gradient anchored at the behavior velocity without learning an additional reward-tilted target score. item.title: Queuing for Secrets: Model-Based Remote Timing Attacks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Remote timing attacks exploit variations in response times to infer sensitive information about remote systems. Their effectiveness, however, is often limited by the difficulty of accurately modeling the stochastic nature of server-side response times, taking into account the intrinsic variability of the service time of a request and the impact of varying workloads on the observed response times. In this article, we propose a new stochastic framework for remote timing attacks based on queuing models and Bayesian statistics. We assume that the attacker knows the service time distributions of two classes of requests and that the information leakage occurs when a malicious observer can distinguish with high probability the class based on the observed response times in the presence of noise induced by exogenous workload. Our experimental evaluation on popular websites demonstrates the practical viability of the approach: our attack outperforms formal techniques based on deterministic service times and existing empirical techniques, while requiring less tuning and fewer hyper-parameters compared to previous formal approaches. Overall, our results show that principled stochastic modeling…

item.title: Pudding: A Retargetable Compiler for Processing-Using-DRAM Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Processing-Using-DRAM（PUD）架构在 DRAM 阵列内做布尔运算、消除数据搬移瓶颈，但不同架构的原语集、行分配模型、执行指标各异，现有编译器硬编码这些差异、跨架构不可复用。

方法：Pudding 可重定向端到端编译框架：架构描述成为编译流水线一等对象，换架构只需提供描述；基于 MLIR 双层运行——张量层（位切片、混合精度分配、ILP 放置减少 PUD 命令与跨 bank 搬移）、逻辑层（等式饱和探索布尔网络实现，重写规则与成本函数从架构描述导出）。

关键数字：多个 PUD 目标、同一套编译 pass 下匹配（部分超越）架构特定手调编译器，同时获得可重定向性与可扩展性。

为什么值得看：把 PUD 架构差异从编译器代码中剥离，一次编写多架构复用。

item.title: PsyDrift: Healthy-Reference Latent Diffusion for Anomaly Scoring in Autism Spectrum Disorder
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Individual heterogeneity and acquisition-site variability complicate neuroimaging-based characterization of autism spectrum disorder (ASD). We propose PsyDrift, combining ASD/healthy-control-supervised functional-connectivity representations with healthy-reference latent diffusion. An encoder produces 128-dimensional representations, and a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) learns exclusively from healthy training latents. Distance from a diffusion-denoised reconstruction provides a continuous deviation score. We evaluate 1,102 subjects from all 20 ABIDE-I sites using five-seed leave-one-site-out cross-validation. The classifier and DDPM achieve mean-site AUROCs of $0.798 \pm 0.003$ and $0.718 \pm 0.013$, respectively; uncertainties denote seed standard deviations. Matched healthy-reference scorers on the same representation achieve 0.68-0.71; the statistical significance of diffusion's modest numerical advantage remains unestablished. Within ASD, scores show weak associations with ADOS Total (Spearman $ρ= 0.108$, $p = 0.038$) and full-scale IQ ($ρ= -0.138$, $p = 0.002$), without adjustment for age, sex, site, or head motion. Frozen evaluation without retraining or hype…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Precision-Aware Learning Rate Transfer Across Block Count in LLM Post-Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

The post-training of pretrained large language models, including supervised finetuning (SFT), direct preference optimization (DPO), and reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR), is very sensitive to the learning rate, and tuning it through grid search is costly in both computation and memory. In this work, we propose \textbf{TipSweep}, a method to transfer the learning rate across the number of trainable transformer blocks. To do so efficiently, we search for the best learning rate by training only the last $k_0$ blocks (in our experiments, typically $k_0=1$), and provide scaling rules that predict the optimal learning rate when training any set of $k$ blocks, including when $k=L$ (the full transformer). Across experiments with models ranging from 1 to 7 billion parameters, we observe that the optimal learning rate follows precision-dependent scaling rules: the optimal rate scales approximately as $k^{-1}$ with float32 (FP32) master weights, but as $k^{-1/2}$ when updates are applied directly to bfloat16 (BF16) weights without a master copy. We explain both rules using an analytical model that accounts for update rounding, under assumptions supported by profiling experi…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Potential Games for Self-Neighborhood Channel Mixing in Graph Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Graph message passing must balance two competing objectives: incorporating neighborhood signals while preserving node-specific information. We model this trade-off as a game in which nodes choose how to mix their own representations with strict-neighborhood aggregates. For fixed channel representations, task supervision defines a common-payoff game, while local distinctness payoffs induce an exact potential game whose potential is the degree-normalized strict Dirichlet energy. We introduce CG2, which amortizes these choices through a shared six-parameter policy per layer based on local channel statistics and can be trained using either objective. Controlled comparisons show that the shared task-trained policy improves mean performance over fixed mixing on three of five heterophily benchmarks, with significant gains on two, while free per-node actions trained with either objective rarely improve on the same baseline. On the ECHO long-range benchmark, the clearest contribution of the gate appears on eccentricity, where the task-trained policy substantially reduces prediction error.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Placing the Control Plane: Cloud-Native Federated Learning Across Batch-Scheduled HPC
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

The United Kingdom's AI Research Resource (AIRR) opens national supercomputers to a community familiar with always-reachable cloud services. With batch-scheduled HPC, a user requests a time-bounded allocation that is then reclaimed. Federated Learning (FL) exposes this tension, pairing a long-lived control plane with short-lived training. We characterize the resulting placement asymmetry: the coordination server sees only model updates and control metadata, so it can sit on neutral infrastructure, whereas the client control process is bound to the participating site's data and must remain within its trust boundary. The outbound-only connection this implies is also how edge clients connect, though the batch-scheduler mismatch is specific to HPC. We demonstrate a cross-silo federation spanning three independently administered systems (Isambard-AI, Isambard 3, and Zenith) using unmodified production FL frameworks (FLARE-wrapped Flower), measure the cost the client placement incurs, and propose Kubernetes-as-a-service as the in-boundary home for the persistent process.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: PackLoop: Row-Packed Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models under Concurrency
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：循环语言模型每 token 复用一块权重 T 次，自回归解码每 token 付 T 次顺序 pass；自投机解码单请求恢复 2-10x，但并发共享 GPU 时增益消退，现行做法是负载升高时减少投机。

方法：PackLoop 基于一条原则——只在本来就会读的行内投机：深循环把位置积累成块在一行内推进；上下文拷贝提案加入首循环已读的行；闭合形式准入规则（库存理论的经济订货量）从每引擎标定一次的成本模型决定积累多久；FP32 下输出与自回归逐 token 相同。

关键数字：164 个负载点（3 GPU、4 个 Ouro 模型、6 基准、最长 32K 上下文）中 161 点快于逐点最优现有调度（中位 1.25x、最高 1.76x），从不显著更慢；并发与上下文越长增益越大。

为什么值得看：把并发下投机失效归因于布局而非投机本身，位一致 + 显著加速。

item.title: PVFormer: Proper Velocity Transformer for Stable and Scalable Hyperbolic Representation Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Hyperbolic representations have shown remarkable success on hierarchical and tree-like data, and Transformers have become a central architecture for representation learning. However, a principled construction of hyperbolic Transformers remains challenging because the self-attention layer decomposes into three coupled primitives, transformation, similarity, and aggregation, that should all respect the underlying geometry. Existing hyperbolic Transformer designs are typically built in the Poincaré or Lorentz models, where bounded domains, time-like constraints, tangent-space detours, or projection steps make it difficult to keep the full block intrinsic and scalable. To address this gap, we propose PVFormer, to the best of our knowledge, the first Transformer architecture that operates natively in proper velocity (PV) space. The proper velocity model provides an unconstrained representation of hyperbolic geometry, and PVFormer exploits this structure to redesign the Transformer block in PV space. On the transformation side, we use PV homomorphism transformations to update query and value representations. On the similarity side, we generalize Euclidean inner-product attention with a P…

item.title: Operator-Valued Q-Learning: Compositional Bellman Recursions for Order-Sensitive Decision Making
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

In quantum pulse sequences, spacecraft attitude control and in-hand reorientation, actions act on a hidden physical state as non-commuting operators, so the outcome of a plan depends on the order of its actions. We let the value function carry this structure: each Q(s,a) is an N x N operator, and the Bellman backup applies the action's dual map to the continuation value, Q(s,a) = K_a^*(R(s,a) + gamma E V(s')). Unrolled along a plan, the recursion builds the ordered product of the actions' operators, and the value at any latent state is a linear trace readout. It is exact for policies that do not observe the latent, the backup contracts for unitary and orthogonal dynamics, and an asynchronous operator TD scheme learns it with almost-sure convergence. Classical values live in a lattice, so a maximum over actions exists; self-adjoint operators form an anti-lattice (Kadison) and have none. An operator log-sum-exp still gives one operator per state-action pair whose readout upper-bounds the value of every policy at every latent state. The sampled update converges to it for a finite horizon, and it reduces to soft Q-learning and the QMDP bound when actions commute. We prove that scalar v…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: One Structure Is Enough: Record-Native Tiles for Evolving Sparse Matrices on GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：随时间演进的稀疏矩阵（如流式图）在 GPU 上通常用打包格式（CSR/ELL/SELL）计算 + 独立缓冲更新，定期维护合并/重建/换格式——这种分裂是否必要？

方法：RecTile 分片存储层：每片保持在一个 12 字节边记录的有序数组；全 GPU 摄取流水线处理插入/删除/修改批；精确动态规划 oracle 在动作空间与标定成本模型下决策折叠。

关键数字：碎片矩阵（每片 1-21 非零）下与最优 format-pinned slab 片时间比 0.56-1.21x；分片布局比整矩阵 cuSPARSE CSR 快最多 21x；摄取流水线最高 2900 万边/秒、比 host 路径快 4.5x；标准折叠启发式用 4-15x GPU 时间、最多 4x 持久存储；5 个演进图工作负载时间-存储权衡全部改善。

为什么值得看：挑战"计算格式+更新缓冲"二分范式，单一可变记录结构 + 全 GPU 摄取。

item.title: NeuroMotion: Aligning EEG to Discrete Motion Primitives for Continuous Motion Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

EEG-to-motion decoding remains challenging because noisy scalp EEG is difficult to map directly to continuous kinematics. We present NeuroMotion, a framework that aligns EEG representations to discrete motion primitives for continuous motion decoding across heterogeneous paradigms, including full-body free movement, lower-limb treadmill locomotion, and upper-limb freewill reaching and grasping. A VQ-based motion prior discretizes continuous motion into reusable primitives that serve as both alignment prototypes and intermediate prediction targets. Prototypical and supervised contrastive objectives align EEG embeddings to motion-derived prototypes and organize them according to primitive assignments. An E2M Transformer predicts motion-code sequences from the learned EEG representations, while a final geometric refinement stage improves continuous trajectory reconstruction through motion-level training. Under a last-session test protocol, NeuroMotion achieves the best mean reconstruction performance among the compared EEG decoding baselines across all three datasets, with the clearest gains on full-body motion in both reconstruction accuracy and distribution-level quality. item.title: Near-Far Attention: Region-Aware Sparse Retrieval for Long-Context LLM Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：稀疏注意力降低长上下文解码成本，但 token 选择引入额外打分/排序开销；统一页打分忽略近/远上下文的相关性差异。

方法：Near-Far Attention（NFA）：prefill 期轻量门估计器识别解码时可跳过的区域；校准无关子空间提取器提供页级与 token 级打分共享的紧凑特征；距离感知两级选择器对近/远页差异化打分，共享预算下联合排序候选 token。

关键数字：门估计器对 dense-prefill 时间增加 <1%；多模型族/参数量/GQA-MLA 架构下聚合任务质量与全注意力相当；Qwen3-8B 512K 上下文较 FlashInfer 算子加速最高 5.49x、整模型解码 2.97x（含选择开销）。

为什么值得看：区域感知的稀疏注意力检索，近远页差异化打分，解码加速显著。

item.title: Measuring GPU Memory Traffic on the NVIDIA GB10 Without C2C Telemetry
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：GB10（DGX Spark 等）的 GPU 无本地内存，L2 miss 都经 NVLink C2C 访问 CPU die 侧 LPDDR5X，但软件不暴露该流量计数器，如何实测？

方法：用 GPU 的 5 个 L2 sector 计数器，经 CUPTI 采样接口每 10ms 采样（进程不附加到工作负载），实测 GPU 内存流量并分离 copy engine 流量与 GPU kernel 读 miss/写；方法以开源工具发布。

关键数字：大流式传输与已知尺寸对比：Acer GN100 内一致 0.28%、DGX Spark 0.005%；跟踪搬运总量、排除 L2 复用数据；SMMU 计数器数的是地址翻译而非字节；实测 Mistral 7B 解码每 token 读 13.47 GiB（权重+KV 缓存），为 NVIDIA 标称带宽的 83%。

为什么值得看：无专用遥测硬件的系统上测量 GPU 内存流量的实用开源方法。

阅读原文

方法：用 GPU 的 5 个 L2 sector 计数器，经 CUPTI 采样接口每 10ms 采样（进程不附加到工作负载），实测 GPU 内存流量并分离 copy engine 流量与 GPU kernel 读 miss/写；方法以开源工具发布。

关键数字：大流式传输与已知尺寸对比：Acer GN100 内一致 0.28%、DGX Spark 0.005%；跟踪搬运总量、排除 L2 复用数据；SMMU 计数器数的是地址翻译而非字节；实测 Mistral 7B 解码每 token 读 13.47 GiB（权重+KV 缓存），为 NVIDIA 标称带宽的 83%。

为什么值得看：无专用遥测硬件的系统上测量 GPU 内存流量的实用开源方法。

item.title: Making Protocol Effects Explicit: LLM-to-Packet Simulation for Superpod Interconnect Exploration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 规模与上下文超单设备内存，跨设备分片带来通信开销，推动大规模高带宽低延迟 scale-up 互联（superpod）；探索设计需精确仿真，而延迟-带宽模型忽略争用与协议效应。

方法：ProtoBridge，基于 ns-3 的 LLM-to-packet 仿真器：操作到包（OTP）层捕获协议特定包交换与依赖；包执行（PEX）层把共享包级机制接入 ns-3 事件系统；另派生替代模型（surrogate）结合 OTP 参数与 PEX 解析模型加速评估。

关键数字：H200 NVLink4 平均延迟误差 17.8%、C500 MetaXLink 10.3%；评估时间从每操作 2.38-75.70s 降至 20.5μs；用于分析 scale-up 内存池与共封装光学（CPO）两种新兴设计。

为什么值得看：把协议效应显式化的 superpod 互联仿真工具，支撑未来 LLM 集群架构探索。

item.title: MTL-MHOL: Predicting Online Conversions under Delayed Feedback and Data Sparsity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

This paper proposes the model-agnostic Multi-Task Learning Multi-Head Online Learning (MTL-MHOL) framework for conversion rate (CVR) prediction. Existing approaches typically address key challenges in CVR prediction, such as delayed feedback and data sparsity, in isolation or lack flexibility and practical applicability. MTL-MHOL adopts a time bucketing approach to account for delayed feedback and combines it with multi-task learning of an auxiliary task to mitigate data sparsity. We evaluate the framework on proprietary datasets from a private company and on a public dataset from Criteo. MTL-MHOL matches or outperforms all benchmark models in terms of Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) and Relative Cross Entropy (RCE), and it correctly captures temporal trends in the data using an MLP backbone, while maintaining strong performance with a DeepFM backbone. In particular, MTL-MHOL matches the performance of the advanced delayed-feedback method FSIW, outperforms the entire-space approach ESMM by 21.5% in RCE, and achieves up to 81% lift in RCE compared to the best-performing classical benchmark.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Low-Rank Tensor Representations for Efficient Multimarginal Optimal Transport
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Multimarginal Optimal Transport (MOT) suffers from exponential computational and memory costs in the number of marginals, as transport plans are represented by high-dimensional tensors. We introduce Low-Rank Multimarginal Optimal Transport (LRMOT), which restricts transport plans to tensors with bounded multilinear rank, providing a compact and structured representation of multimarginal couplings. This structure enables efficient algorithms with a low memory footprint. We establish approximation bounds for the resulting low-rank formulations and demonstrate experimentally that the proposed algorithms substantially reduce computational time while achieving solutions with low transport cost.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Learning Teacher Output Preferences from Final Responses for Reasoning Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Many large language models (LLMs) use chain-of-thought (CoT) to solve complex problems, but hide their CoT traces to prevent reasoning capabilities from being distilled. While recent studies have shown that hidden CoTs can be reconstructed, existing methods typically require training a separate attacker for each target LLM. This paper studies model-agnostic CoT reconstruction, aiming to reconstruct hidden CoT traces from arbitrary target LLMs using only input prompts and visible final responses. We propose Final-Output Preference Learning (FOPL), which trains a single reconstruction model that generalizes to unseen LLMs without target-specific adaptation. To achieve this, the reconstruction model must learn which reasoning patterns match a given final response without knowing the target LLM's identity. We address this using preference optimization, training the reconstruction model to prefer native CoTs over synthetic alternatives for the same question and final response. By learning these preferences from LLMs with accessible CoTs, the reconstruction model learns to distinguish reasoning patterns based on visible responses. item.title: IP-GNO: An Inductive Physics-Informed Graph Neural Operator for Automated Distribution System State Estimation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Distribution System State Estimation (DSSE) is a crucial tool for real-time monitoring, operation, and control of the new-age distribution systems (DSs) due to intensified voltage fluctuations and operational uncertainties introduced by volatile power injection at the nodes. Existing GNN-based approaches generally exhibit limited generalization across networks with different sizes and topologies, making zero-shot cross-grid transfer to unseen DSs a significant challenge. To overcome the aforementioned challenges, this article proposes an Inductive Physics-Informed Graph Neural Operator (IP-GNO) for scalable and transferable DSSE. The proposed framework frames complex bus voltage estimation as an operator-learning problem inspired by the Neumann series expansion of the inverse bus admittance matrix. An admittance-parameterized kernel, incorporating a self-admittance gate in the zeroth-order term and a persistent source-injection skip connection across network layers, captures the underlying electrical dependencies. Additionally, a Physics-Embedded Tree Encoding (PETE) scheme introduces five grid-size-invariant positional features derived from path impedance and a DC-linearized phase…

item.title: How Do Deep Networks Encode and Selectively Use Information? Shared Encoding and Conditional Signed Readout in Vision and Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

How can trained deep networks retain contextual information across internal representations while using it selectively in a decision? We study this question through controlled background-texture edits in vision classifiers and entity-binding edits in frozen language models. Across both modalities, factor perturbations preserve recognizable structure across pre-fixed, mutually disjoint blocks of hidden units: visual channel blocks match their complements more closely for the same image than for other images under the same texture edit, while language blocks transfer a relational direction fitted under one query role to rank relational states within held-out name pairs under the other role. We then decompose the local output change into signed channel and pathway contributions. In a convolutional classifier, net channel-level reinforcement ($R^{(512)}>1$) coexists on individual images with cancellation between positive- and negative-weight groups ($R^{(2)}<1$). Holding weights, the paired relation edit, and red/blue answer words fixed, switching prompt presentation reverses the mean finite selection effect in Qwen2.5. item.title: HLWalk: Modal-Split Random-Walk Thermal Analysis for Heterogeneous 2.5D/3D ICs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Efficient thermal analysis is essential for accelerating the design of 2.5D/3D ICs. However, existing random-walk thermal solvers can suffer from boundary discretization errors and high computational costs when resolving fine-scale structures such as through-silicon vias (TSVs). To address these challenges, we propose HLWalk, an efficient random-walk thermal solver for heterogeneous 2.5D/3D ICs. We introduce local boundary integral reconstruction to eliminate discretization errors in local-time-based boundary treatments. To accelerate boundary preprocessing, we employ modal splitting: low-order modes are computed deterministically, while Monte Carlo sampling estimates only the residual. We further develop scale-aware random-walk transport to efficiently resolve fine-scale structures without requiring fine discretization throughout the domain. Experiments on 2.5D/3D IC benchmarks show that HLWalk achieves remarkable wall-clock speedup and better accuracy across settings.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: HEART: Hierarchical Expert Adaptive Refinement Transformer for ECG Representation Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Learning robust representations from electrocardiograms (ECGs) is challenging because repeated cardiac cycles coexist with subtle and sparse diagnostic cues in local morphology and rhythm-level context. Existing ECG foundation models commonly rely on Transformerbased patch encoders with uniformly shared dense refinement pathways, limiting adaptive processing across heterogeneous ECG tokens. We propose HEART (Hierarchical Expert Adaptive Refinement Transformer), an ECG foundation model that introduces stage-specific conditional expert refinement during self-supervised pre-training. HEART places a local-level MoE over patch-level representations before temporal contextualization and a global-level MoE over context-integrated token representations after self-attention. Token-level Top-1 routing allows different patches or contextual tokens within the same ECG to follow different expert pathways. On public ECG benchmarks, HEART achieves strong performance under both linear probing and fine-tuning, with particularly large frozen-encoder gains on PTB-XL Form and Rhythm (+6.76 AUROC points each over the strongest protocol-reproduced baseline). Routing analyses provide qualitative evidence…

item.title: GC-MoE K3: A Green-Context Role Graph for Latent Mixture-of-Experts Decode
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Kimi K3 潜在路由 MoE + 全宽共享专家，完整前馈求值需评分选专家、投影到潜在空间、跨 expert-parallel rank 交换 token、计算路由与共享分支、归一化合并——如何在数据中心 Blackwell 上高效调度？

方法：GC-MoE K3 把整个求值调度为跨两个 Green Context 的 CUDA Graph：五个基础角色分工（输入投影、路由、派发、专家计算、收尾）；派发填充路由输入环与共享专家计算并行；收尾按 token 等待专家 owner，重叠路由归约与 RMSNorm 及输出投影权重加载；条件角色复用通信分区做路由计算与 split-K 归约。

关键数字：GB200 上 EP8/EP16/EP32 全部 24 个测量配置快于 SGLang 风格参考（平均 1.1324x）；对比历史 vLLM 风格测量 24 形状平均 1.3651x；数值套件 142 例全过、2,936 项 rank 检查。

为什么值得看：潜在 MoE 解码的 CUDA Graph 工程范式，Blackwell 数据中心推理直接参考。

item.title: Fast 4-bit KV-Cache Decoding on Hopper GPUs: Why Existing Kernels Are Slow and How to Fix Them
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：4-bit KV 缓存读字节约为 FP8 一半，但 Hopper 无 FP4 硬件、每字节带宽的指令发射能力有限，4-bit 值需软件解码；H200 上 vLLM NVFP4 路径仅达 10-20% 带宽、比 FP8 慢最多 1.7x。

方法：定位慢因（FlashInfer NVFP4、Triton UltraQuant 执行 2-6x Hopper 发射预算、加载/解码/矩阵乘串行化）后设计 Hopper 原生 kernel：TMA producer warp 与两个计算 warpgroup 重叠、写入时布局缓存使解码值直接从寄存器进张量核、交换矩阵操作数免小查询组填充。

关键数字：H200 batch 32-128 达峰值带宽 67-75%；11 种形状比 XQA/FlashAttention-4 FP8 快 1.12-1.49x；vLLM 内 Llama-3.1-8B batch≥8 每步比 FlashInfer FP8 快 1.12-1.64x；推理型负载下 99% 请求达标最高速率达 FP8 的 1.23-2.20x；5 个 7B-32B 模型精度与 BF16 KV 无显著差异。

为什么值得看：4-bit KV 解码 kernel 的深度剖析与修复，vLLM 推理直接受益。

item.title: EdgeALM: An Efficient and Unified Edge Accelerator for Large Audio Language Models via Full-Stack Hardware-Software Co-Design and Agent-Driven Recursive Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：音频语言模型（ALM）边缘部署受模型体量大、负载异构、软件支持少的制约。

方法：EdgeALM 统一 FPGA 加速器，全栈软硬件协同设计 + agent 驱动递归优化：AWQ 风格量化器 + 模态条件词表剪枝的端到端压缩流；Conv-Matmul 解耦架构（专用矩阵/卷积引擎并发）；超粗粒度 ISA 把常规片上数据搬移与执行序列并入计算指令。

关键数字：单块 Alveo U50 桌面 PC 上跑 20+ 模型（含 13B 参数，8GB HBM 内）；音频转文本最高 169.5 tok/s；流式音频推理 94% 带宽利用率、平均 26W；较 EdgeLLM 等支持更大模型与更广负载。

item.title: EEG Decoding in Context: A Framework for Tuning-Free EEG Foundation Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Electroencephalography (EEG) decoding is a central route toward brain-computer interfaces for communication, rehabilitation, cognitive assessment, and neurological monitoring. Recent EEG foundation models have substantially advanced reusable signal representations, but their downstream use still typically requires a task-specific decoder, gradient-based adaptation, and validation-driven model selection. We investigate a complementary foundation-model paradigm based on in-context learning: labeled EEG recordings define the decoding task as context, and new recordings are predicted without updating model parameters. We first pair raw EEG features with a pretrained general-purpose in-context predictor. This direct formulation provides a promising starting point, but its performance remains limited and unstable and does not generalize reliably across EEG paradigms. We find that suitable context construction can address these limitations by improving the effective signal-to-noise ratio and exposing temporal and spatial structure. Building on this insight, we introduce a general framework that combines EEG-specific context construction with a frozen in-context predictor and a metric-base…

item.title: Doc-to-LoRA Analysis: Query Conditioning, Wrong Facts, and Distractor Interference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Doc-to-LoRA (D2L) compiles documents into low-rank adapters, allowing language models to use their contents without repeatedly processing the original text. We investigate its suitability for internalizing user memories through factual question answering, controlled interventions, and a production MidBrain memory pipeline. Across Gemma-2-2B and Qwen3-4B, D2L loses accuracy relative to in-context learning, with additional documents introducing substantial interference. Single-document errors frequently match answers to other questions about the same passage, suggesting unreliable question-answer attribution. Layer-wise interventions show that interference accumulates across depth, with more concentrated early damage at larger bank sizes on Gemma. With eight documents, applying the full bank in the initial layers gives similar accuracy to withholding all document contributions there. Source membership is detectable in intermediate states, but trained readers do not reliably resolve the interference. On PersonaMem-v2, joint compilation and normalized adapter composition achieve accuracy close to consolidated text memory when retrieved episodes remain text, but the resulting token savi…

item.title: Diagnostic Accuracy Is Not Deployment Value: Decision-Aligned Reliability Evaluation for Foundation MLIPs in Materials Discovery
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

In AI-guided materials discovery, machine-learning models increasingly decide which candidate materials should receive expensive first-principles or experimental evaluation. Standard reliability metrics such as uncertainty, calibration, novelty, and ranking accuracy evaluate properties of the predictions, but success on these metrics does not necessarily imply a better downstream screening decision. We study this mismatch for foundation machine-learned interatomic potentials (MACE-MP, CHGNet, Orb V3) used to rank candidate crystal structures before DFT verification. We evaluate three representative reliability interventions (novelty detection, sparse DFT calibration, and chemistry-level ranking audits) using a deployment objective that measures how much DFT can be avoided while maintaining a required recall of near-hull candidates. Across all three, a reliability signal can succeed on its immediate target without improving the final screening decision: novelty detects distribution shift but weakly ranks failure severity; calibration can improve pooled ranking metrics while leaving screening unchanged or degrading it; and sparse audits identify MLIP-chemistry combinations with poor …

item.title: Decoupling Faults from Uncertainty: Message-Efficient Byzantine Agreement with Local Predictions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Byzantine Agreement protocols are traditionally designed under worst-case uncertainty about which processes are faulty, coupling the adversary's corruption budget $t$ with the system's epistemic uncertainty. Recent work showed that auxiliary failure predictions can improve round complexity, but cannot improve communication complexity when prediction errors are unconstrained. In this paper, we initiate a theoretical study of the complementary question: how much can Byzantine Agreement benefit when each process is guaranteed a local bound on its prediction error? We study this question through the local $k$-error prediction model, in which each process receives a local classification vector differing from the ground truth in at most $k$ positions. The predictions need not be common, and honest processes may hold substantially different views about whom to trust. Under this promise model -- where correctness relies on the local error bound holding -- we present a synchronous Byzantine Agreement algorithm requiring $n \ge t + 4k + 1$, where $n$ is the total number of processes, $t$ is the maximum number of failures, and $k$ is the local error bound per honest process. item.title: Composing Independently Distilled Memory and Retrieval Policies for Long-Term Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

Long-lived Web assistants require effective memory and retrieval mechanisms to access information from past user interactions. While these capabilities can be learned through specialized policies, it remains unclear whether specialists trained independently in different environments can be effectively composed without joint optimization. This paper investigates compositional transfer through policy distillation. Memory-writing and sequential retrieval policies are independently distilled from frontier-model action trajectories into 3B models and combined with a fixed answer generator without downstream training. On a LongMemEval-based benchmark, the distilled composition achieves 73.1% accuracy, compared with 36.2% for a composition of existing RL-trained specialists, and also outperforms the evaluated RL-trained compositions on PersonaMem-v2. Component ablations reveal that improvements in individual policies depend on their composition, highlighting the importance of cross-specialist compatibility. Further task-specific adaptation improves accuracy to 75.2% on LongMemEval through RL and 48.9% on PersonaMem-v2 through supervised distillation. These findings demonstrate the effecti…

item.title: Can Latent Reasoning Drive LLM Outputs Without a Trace?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

LLMs typically solve complex tasks with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, which is also the main tool for monitoring them for misaligned behavior. However, standard transformers can also solve tasks with complete latent reasoning (CLR), carrying out the whole task internally and outputting only the final answer. Theory bounds the depth of CLR, the number of sequential steps it can carry out, and recent work measured it to be shallow. In this work, we ask whether CLR is deep enough for a model to pursue a hidden objective that requires reasoning. Such a model would generate a CoT that appears to solve the given task, while a latent multi-step computation decides its answer based on the hidden objective. First, we show that a simple auxiliary loss allows models to solve a multi-step task latently at least 5x deeper than previously reported. Then, in two common tasks, decision-making and code generation, we train a model to pursue such a hidden objective, which decides a loan or plants a vulnerability. The model's CoT justifies the output with no trace of the hidden objective, and a strong LLM monitor does not flag it. Finally, using activation patching, we find that the latent comput…

item.title: Bridging the Semantic Gap from Natural Language Specifications to RTL with Layered Formal Guidance
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in generating register-transfer level (RTL) code from natural-language specifications, their reliability remains limited on designs with complex control logic and temporal behavior. This stems from a fundamental semantic gap: high-level natural language often leaves implementation-critical details underspecified, forcing LLMs to infer unstated assumptions. This paper presents Layered Formal Guidance, a novel framework that bridges this semantic gap by using formal properties as an intermediate semantic layer between natural-language specifications and RTL generation. Our framework applies formal guidance across three layers: property-driven specification augmentation before generation, property-consistency checking after generation, and counterexample-guided refinement after checking. Experiments on RTLLM benchmarks and various open-source IP designs demonstrate that our framework achieves higher functional correctness and lower sampled output-trace diversity. Furthermore, we show that Layered Formal Guidance can flexibly augment both general-purpose LLMs and domain-specific models to substantially improve their generation relia…

item.title: Attention Temperature Confounds Zero-Shot Context Extension
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

A training-time attention change is usually judged for zero-shot context extension against a dense baseline beyond the training length at the default temperature, $τ= 1$. The outcome depends on how miscalibrated the baseline is there: the share of perplexity it recovers when its logits are sharpened by one scalar. Under the standard recipe (fp32 master weights), an 8k-trained baseline is 8-15% miscalibrated at 30k in three seed-paired 365M twins; in one of them this makes the block-sparse-trained twin look 7% better, which calibration removes. In pure-bf16 training without master weights the miscalibration is several times larger: an AdamW step ($β_2 = 0.95$) on a gain initialised at 1.0 is below half the bf16 spacing at peak learning rates under $1.7\times10^{-3}$, so gains never move (22 checkpoints), the baseline is 37-58% miscalibrated, and block-sparse pretraining, attention dropout and ALiBi look 6-35% better. Calibrating one temperature per model and length removes all three advantages, leaves ALiBi 5% behind RoPE and keeps part of the gain of a positive control, NTK-aware scaling. Unfreezing the gains reverses the block-sparse advantage at 365M and removes 71-89% of it at 1…

item.title: Attention Latent Feedback
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

During autoregressive decoding, the deeper representations of the previous token have already been computed, yet shallow layers at the current token cannot read them directly because standard self-attention connects positions only at the same depth. We introduce Attention Latent Feedback (ALF), an architecture that allows every sublayer to attend to the outputs of the deeper layers at the previous position. Training unrolls this cross-position recurrence into two parallel passes, whereas decoding remains single-pass using cached previous-token states. Across mixture-of-experts models with up to 4.0B parameters, ALF lowers held-out loss by 0.022-0.024 nats over the standard residual with about 1.1% decoding FLOP overhead, and consistently outperforms prior final-state feedback across all three scales on both standard and attention residual backbones. On MoE-1.6B, ALF matches a $1.38\times$ larger baseline token budget, and on MoE-4.0B it lifts average accuracy across seventeen downstream benchmarks from 45.1% to 47.0%. Analysis further reveals that intermediate and nearby deeper layers drive most of this benefit, allowing a fixed nearest-window variant to retain 89%-94% of the gain …

item.title: AnchorCredit: Output-Anchored Credit Assignment for Structured Generation with Multiple Verifiable Rewards
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

In Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and related methods typically compute group-relative advantages from response rewards and broadcast the same advantage to every generated token in a response to guide policy updates. However, we identify a systematic problem of cross-component credit misassignment in tasks with multiple verifiable results, such as joint multi-attribute prediction: low rewards for some components can penalize a well-performing component and its associated reasoning. To address this problem, we propose AnchorCredit. The method uses the policy model's attention from output anchors to preceding reasoning sentences to estimate sentence-component associations and assign component-specific advantages to the relevant reasoning, without additional relevance annotations or a separate relevance discriminator. To support the study of credit assignment with multiple verifiable rewards, we construct ProductAttr, a benchmark of 7,200 real product image-text samples. Experiments show that AnchorCredit outperforms existing baselines on this benchmark. Experiments on the public Nutrition5k dataset further support the …

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 长上下文 LLM 服务须保留每请求完整 KV 缓存，可能超 GPU 显存；CXL-PNM 设备可持全缓存就地算注意力，但现有 GPU-PNM 系统 PNM 为中心，CXL-PNM 带宽远低于 GPU HBM，使 PNM 成瓶颈、GPU 空等。

方法 ANOR 是 GPU-PNM 联合加速系统：利用稀疏注意力的选择局部性，GPU 从近期选择条目缓存算大部分注意力，PNM 只处理 miss；有界缓存更新策略在命中率饱和点停止更新以减链路流量；片上 Early Streaming Buffer 捕获 KV 数据流给 GPU；自适应缓存因子随负载调 GPU 缓存大小。

关键数字 两模型三长上下文 agentic 负载下，解码吞吐较 HiSparse 平均 2.3x、较 PNM 基线平均 2.0x。

为什么值得看 把 PNM 定位为 GPU 内存层级的计算层而非主引擎，纠正 PNM-centric 设计偏差。

item.title: A Systematic Method of GPU Verification on Subsystem Modelling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

ARM Fast Model is a software modelling system for simulating multiple systems IPs integrated in a subsystem. Fast Model allows customer to run whole software stack as early as system IPs' specification is just ready. In this paper, we talk about a systematic method to enable GPU modelling and make whole system software stacks executable for both CPU and GPU in the integrated modelling environment, and eventually the major GPU IP can be verified. With our solution, we can directly run commercial benchmarks like Antutu and GFX Bench in Android target system with underlying ARM Fast Model mobile subsystem support. This was unbelievable in the past due to 3D rendering simulation for GPU verification is very slow. We also introduce some special techniques to improve performance. Eventually the whole software stack can directly work on real hardware without any changes as soon as the first tape-out is ready.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: A Pipeline-Parallel System for Depth-Recurrent Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 深度循环（Looped）模型靠共享块栈多次应用提升有效深度，扩展通常需流水线并行；但常用交错 1F1B 为无环 stage 图设计——栈跨 stage 拆分后同一 stage 被多次访问、后级反喂前级，1F1B 无对应槽位、无法排序、无回边，导致停滞或乱序。

方法 Loop-PP 为这种循环布局重建时间表与通信：同一 stage 的不同迭代分别调度，把 1F1B 骨架特化为全局一致的访问序，每 rank 发射静态指令流、分离 posting 与 waiting 使通信与本地计算重叠。

关键数字 与单 stage 参考逐位一致（bit-identical）；8B–60B MoE 模型上峰值内存最多降 32.8%；固定算力预算下最佳观测吞吐提升 12.7%。

为什么值得看 为循环架构定制流水线并行，bit-identical 验证 + 显存与吞吐双收益。

item.title: A CPU-Only Framework for Mining Collectively-Behaving Bots in MMORPGs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF

MMORPGs continually face automated programs (bots) that disrupt gameplay balance and in-game economies. An unsupervised Transformer framework can mine collectively behaving bot groups, but its multi-GPU training is costly in live operations. We show that such GPU-trained sequence models are not strictly necessary for this task. Our CPU pipeline pairs zone embeddings learned from movement context, which place teleport-linked zones close together, with a training-free coordinate kernel, and then applies density clustering. It trains 3-5$\times$ faster than the GPU-based Transformer (56-86$\times$ on the same CPU) while matching its mining quality on two commercial MMORPGs, and has been deployed since late 2024. We also share deployment lessons on how to set the clustering threshold and when to retrain.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Ziv Meets Sumcheck: Zero-Knowledge Proofs of Floating-Point LLM Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Zero-knowledge proofs can show that a neural network produced a given output without revealing the network, but current systems for language models prove integer approximations of the model rather than the floating-point arithmetic that is actually deployed. Proving floating-point matrix multiplication has been regarded as hard, because rounding after every addition makes the result depend on the order of the additions. We avoid this obstacle by proving the correctly rounded product, in which every dot product is computed exactly and rounded once. This result is independent of the hardware and at least as accurate as standard kernels. We give an interactive proof for this relation whose cost is close to that of integer matrix multiplication, with roughly a thousand times fewer committed values than per-operation floating-point circuits need constraints, extend it to every layer of a transformer, and give a privacy construction for the complete argument whose zero knowledge we prove under explicit hypotheses. We implement the system and prove the full forward pass of GPT-2 small, including all twelve blocks and the output over the whole vocabulary, in 19 minutes on two processor cor…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Zarc: Exact Nearest Neighbors over a Billion Vectors in Seconds
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 精确 kNN 向量搜索处于 ML 系统关键路径（LLM 稀疏注意力、长上下文记忆、训练去重）；穷举 GPU 搜索逐查询扫全量数据，近似索引返回不精确邻居，近年半精度证明方法只能用于单 GPU 全量驻留。

方法 Zarc 只在 GPU 内存保留证明的短行，少数剩余完整向量从主机内存按需取回；支持欧氏、余弦、内积与过滤查询，更新下仍精确。

关键数字 四张 H100 上对十亿向量回答 10,000 个精确查询仅 1.1 秒（基线约五分钟）；11 个开源 LLM 上精确 top-10 注意力键检索较穷举快 2.2x–13.1x；百万 token 稀疏注意力中较 FlashInfer bf16 选择快 3.1x（后者多数查询漏掉精确 top-64）。

为什么值得看 十亿级精确最近邻秒级返回，稀疏注意力等场景直接受益。

item.title: When Does Decomposition Help? Empirical Study on Workload-Architecture Affinity in LLM Inference Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 推理可组织为单体副本、张量/流水线并行组或 prefill/decode 分离；分解是否提效取决于工作负载形状、模型适配与相位资源可否独立缩放，而现有比较常同时改动多个因素。

方法 隔离架构效应：同一四卡 A100-40GB 硬件包络、Qwen3-8B、同软件栈/提示/到达调度下评估 5 种 SGLang 服务组织方式；150 个审计条件覆盖短聊、decode 重与 32K prefill 重负载。

关键数字 4 个独立单卡副本在短聊与长输出下端到端延迟最低、且唯一全条件稳定；流水线并行在非压力速率下 32K 首 token 延迟降 58–59%；混合流水线分离在 0.4 req/s 下 32K 端到端最优；静态 TP2+TP2 拆分无改善、高 32K 负载崩溃。

为什么值得看 隔离架构效应的系统性实证，"分解不是单调优化"对服务架构选型有直接指导。

item.title: When Can a Rewiring Control Test LLM Weight Readers? C2 and an Eligibility Protocol
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Large language models can predict the outputs of small neural networks from raw weights, but success could reflect recognition of weight-space regularities (fingerprints) rather than computation, and function-preserving controls cannot tell these apart. We propose C2, a counterfactual that permutes the columns of a network's final linear readout: every other parameter, and the readout's singular values, norms and entry multiset, are unchanged, and the function can change in an exactly recomputable way; we verify that each evaluated permutation does. C2 separates fingerprinting from computation only under three conditions, which we state as an eligibility protocol: a strategy restricted to C2-invariant summaries must already predict the target; C2 must change a property specific to the rewiring; and the reader's identity must be attested. No natural setting we tested is eligible. On tiny MLPs a frontier reader route followed the rewired function on all 24 networks, but invariant baselines were near chance and its backend could not be attested. In two public CNN zoos the conditions traded off: weight statistics predicted CIFAR-10 accuracy in-distribution, but C2's effect on accuracy …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Towards Global Counterfactual-Based Self-Explainable Graph Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Graph Counterfactual Explanations (GCEs) have emerged as an effective approach for interpreting Graph Neural Network (GNN) predictions by identifying minimal graph modifications needed to change predictions. However, existing methods suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) They rely on a post-hoc explanation paradigm, where a separate explainer is trained after the GNN. This sequential optimization prevents the explainer from leveraging how the GNN learned its representations, often resulting in lower-quality explanations. (2) They are largely local, generating counterfactual explanations only for individual samples. Consequently, they fail to capture generalizable patterns across the data distribution, a crucial gap for applications like drug discovery, where global principles enable systematic decision-making across thousands of cases. To address these limitations, we propose GCSGNN (Global Counterfactual-based Self-explainable GNN), a unified framework that integrates counterfactual generation into the GNN architecture, encouraging explanations that faithfully reflect the model's decision-making process. Beyond local explanations, GCSGNN discovers shared latent patterns inf…

item.title: Towards Edge Artificial Intelligence for Predicting Antimicrobial Resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB) poses a major challenge to global tuberculosis control, as multidrug-resistant strains limit available treatment options. Rapid and accurate prediction of drug resistance from genomic data could support timely treatment decisions and public health interventions. However, many existing computational approaches for genomic AMR prediction rely on computationally intensive pipelines, limiting their suitability for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. This limitation is particularly relevant in hospital settings in low- and middle-income countries, where computing infrastructure and access to high-performance computational resources may be limited. To address this challenge, we present a lightweight, novel machine learning (ML) approach suitable for running on edge devices that combines 4-mer frequency features derived from whole-genome sequences with a Random Forest classifier to predict antibiotic resistance in MTB. The proposed ML approach achieved an average area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.82 across 20 antibiotics on an independent test set.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: The Complexity of Full-Information Iterated Protocols
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Full-information protocols are a common abstraction in distributed computing. In its iterated form, processes proceed through successive communication rounds in which each process shares its entire current knowledge of the execution. Usually, it is implicitly assumed that a process can transmit an unbounded amount of information in every round. This paper makes that assumption explicit and studies its computational cost. We formalize the problem of simulating iterated full-information protocols when communication is bounded, so that each process may share at most $b$ bits with every other process per round. We show that for a large family of shared-memory communication models and $n+1$ processes, simulating $r$ iterations of the full-information protocol requires \(Ω\!\left((n!)^{r-1} 2^{\,n-b}\right)\) rounds. We complement this lower bound with simulation algorithms that are asymptotically optimal in the conventional read-write model. In particular, the case of two processes is special: $r$ iterations of a full-information protocol can be simulated in exactly $r$ rounds while using only $2$-bit variables, as the amount of information that must be represented remains bounded for t…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

Graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to learn transferable representations across domains with heterogeneous node attributes and graph structures. However, relations inferred from node attributes can rely on domain-specific feature semantics, limiting their transferability to unseen graphs, particularly in low-label regimes. We propose THETA (Topology-aware HEat-based TrAnsfer), a graph foundation model that leverages Heat Kernel Signatures (HKS) as a topology-based structural prior for cross-domain transfer. By characterizing nodes' heat-return behavior across diffusion scales, HKS provides a common structural descriptor across graphs without requiring aligned attribute semantics, complementing feature-based relations with information about local and multiscale connectivity. THETA incorporates this prior into both pre-training and few-shot adaptation. During pre-training, it combines HKS with node attributes to construct refined graph views and trains a shared encoder via contrastive learning. item.title: SleepXA: Composing Pretrained Neural and Cardiac Foundation Models for Sleep Representation Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Physiological signals recorded during sleep provide synchronized views of neural, cardiac, respiratory, and other bodily systems, while preserving modality-specific information. Existing EEG and ECG foundation models already capture rich but distinct physiological structure, motivating an alternative to training a multimodal sleep model from scratch: composing existing pretrained models. We introduce SleepXA, a framework that uses synchronized polysomnography (PSG) to compose independently pretrained neural and cardiac foundation models. SleepXA combines pretrained EEG and ECG encoders with lightweight encoders for additional PSG modalities, and learns shared and modality-specific representations through sleep-guided alignment. We pretrain SleepXA on 9,230 overnight PSG recordings from three large cohorts and evaluate it on 27 downstream tasks spanning sleep representation, clinical and disease prediction, and daytime physiological transfer. SleepXA ranks among the top two methods on 22 of 27 tasks. item.title: Selecting Stable Sampling Dynamics for Compositional Diffusion: A Feynman-Kac Weight Reduction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Given $K$ separately trained diffusion models, how should one sample from a $β_k$-weighted product of their terminal laws without jointly retraining the experts? Existing Feynman--Kac constructions provide many weighted stochastic differential equations (SDEs) with the correct target marginal. The consequential question is how to select useful proposal dynamics among them. We study an explicit family of weighted diffusions that realizes the same product-of-intermediate-experts trajectory. A scalar parameter $λ$ controls how strongly the proposal drift follows the composed expert score, while an additional Langevin component can be varied independently. Writing $B=\sum_{k=1}^{K}β_k>0$, we identify the distinguished choice $λ=1/B$. At this value, the aggregate squared-score term in the instantaneous Feynman--Kac log-weight rate cancels exactly. For positive expert exponents, the remaining score-disagreement contribution is non-positive. We call this structural cancellation Feynman--Kac reduction. item.title: RumiFold: Teaching an LLM to Natively Fold Proteins and Reason About Their Function
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Can we teach a general-purpose language model to fold proteins? And if so, what does learning to fold enable beyond structure prediction itself? We introduce RumiFold, a pretrained chat model that learns to predict protein structures directly from its own hidden states. RumiFold processes proteins through repeated folding passes, then uses these folded representations to answer questions in natural language. It achieves folding accuracy comparable to dedicated single-representation models such as SimpleFold, alongside state-of-the-art performance on Gene Ontology protein function prediction and free-text function description. We find that folding pretraining organizes the model's hidden states around protein function, creating an internal per-residue workspace that is biologically grounded. Causal interventions show that this folded workspace links structure and language when RumiFold predicts function, providing rich representations for biomolecular reasoning. We see RumiFold as a step toward native biomolecular intelligence: where protein-based computations and language-based reasoning become integrated capabilities of general-purpose language models. item.title: Recursive Self-Editing: LLMs Program Their Own Weight Edits for Self-Improvement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Recursive self-improvement asks a system to improve the very system that improves it. Today's language models improve themselves through data, training recipes or scaffolds. Whenever their weights change, gradient descent writes the update, not the model. We let the model write its own weights. In SELFWRITE, each generation the current model studies its own reasoning on fresh training problems, inspects its own weights and activations in a persistent Python session, and writes a program that constructs a low-rank weight edit for itself from white-box primitives (singular directions, activation contrasts between its right and wrong answers, rank-one projections, tensor computations), with no training or gradient tool. Every candidate is graded once on a hidden gate set against the current model; the best strictly improving edit is merged into the weights, and the edited model writes the next edit. On Qwen3.8-27B and math problems from DAPO-Math, five generations of SELFWRITE raise gate accuracy from 73.95% to 76.45% and accuracy on a held-out test split that the loop never sees from 76.30% to 77.75% (avg@4) and from 82.60% to 84.80% (pass@4), without a single gradient step. item.title: QASparse: Query-Adaptive Sparse Attention with Tailored Budgets and Tokens
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 长序列 LLM 推理的 prefill 成本高，密集注意力随上下文长度平方增长；跨 head 相似性可减少冗余计算，但 head 间相似不代表查询需求一致，预算与 token 选择需按查询区域适配。

方法 QASparse 查询自适应稀疏注意力：局部预算回归沿查询位置建模计算需求、为不同查询区域与 head 估预算；边界投票让每个 head 内的查询用真实 query/key 分数对选择截止线附近候选投票，精化保留集；再设计长度特化选择 kernel 支持动态预算执行。

关键数字 较现有稀疏注意力基线改进基准分数并加快 prefill attention 计算（摘要未给出具体量化数字）。

为什么值得看 共享估计 + 局部决策结合的查询自适应稀疏注意力，兼顾效率与硬件执行。

item.title: Pain Reassessment from Pulse Waveforms with Language Model Explanations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF

Routine photoplethysmography (PPG) offers a continuous physiological signal for pain reassessment between self-reports. Whether prior recordings provide an individualized physiological reference beyond care-process timing remains unresolved. Across 52,082 report-linked assessments from 21,514 patients in MIMIC-III critical care and MC-MED emergency care, we evaluate a workflow that pairs longitudinal PPG representations with local evidence-linked language interpretation. Among 27 methods, source-selected full-history models achieved average precision of 0.824 from critical to emergency care and 0.822 in reverse. Removing historical pulse-run representations while retaining reassessment availability and elapsed time lowered critical-to-emergency four-hour within-patient concordance from 0.718 to 0.534. This comparison supports the contribution of prior pulse-run representations to within-patient ordering beyond timing cues. Across 2,905 test patients, a local Qwen model interpreting frozen predictions achieved a 94.7% patient-equal pass rate on automated evidence checks after at most one revision. Longitudinal pulse context and evidence-linked language interpretation support a patie…

item.title: Ossim: OS-Driven Live Simulation for Cluster-Scale Full-Stack Evaluation (Extended Version)
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 集群规模全栈模拟需同时满足未修改生产栈的全栈保真与迭代配置探索所需的模拟性能，现有方法无法兼得。

方法 Ossim 是构建在 Linux 虚拟化栈上的 OS 级方法，含四个子系统：模拟导向调度、实时内存层级管理、模拟感知 IPC、多主机协调；在共享模拟时间下协调 live 与建模组件、控制共置 live VM 间干扰。

关键数字 论文未披露具体量化指标，聚焦机制设计：让模拟控制与编排成为 OS 核心职责的 simulation-native 方向。

为什么值得看 把模拟控制与编排提升为 OS 原生责任，是集群全栈评估的系统级新思路。

item.title: One Checkpoint, Four Converters: Per Input Disagreement After On Device Conversion and a Probe Set That Catches It
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-22　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 设备端/加速推理的模型转换以 top-1 准确率匹配源模型即上线，但准确率匹配时单个决策可能改变；转换器、INT8 配方与校准各有影响。

方法 用 ExecuTorch、LiteRT、ONNX Runtime、TensorRT 的 FP32 与 INT8 文档配方转换 5 个公开 checkpoint（4 个 ImageNet 分类器 + 1 个情感模型），在 7,854 张图与 1,938 个句子上逐 top-1 决策与 PyTorch 源对比。

关键数字 34 个严格 FP32 转换逐决策复现；4 个保准确率的视觉 INT8 配方均翻转 >1% 决策：ONNX Runtime 静态 INT8 翻转 ResNet-50 4.07% 决策（准确率仅 −0.15 点），同配方不同校准构建间分歧 3.44%；200 个最小源 margin 训练输入组成的探针集召回全部 40 个视觉栈（95% CI 0.91–1.00）。

为什么值得看 证明准确率等价 ≠ 决策等价，给出转换前即可选定的探针集做验收。
