item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Iterative Scarcity-Guided Exploration: Bootstrapping Generative Auto-bidding from Narrow Support

Auto-bidding is a core algorithmic component in online advertising auctions. In practical cold-start settings, iterative training is commonly used to compensate for low-quality, narrowly supported historical data. Unfortunately, in iterative training, representative diffusion-based AI-Generated Bidding (AIGB) methods fail to sustain extrapolation beyond the narrow data support and stagnate at a suboptimal level. In this paper, we theoretically attribute this stagnation to Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) collapse: the weak radial return signal is overwhelmed by a curvature-induced penalty. To break this stagnation, we propose \textbf{Iterative Scarcity-Guided Exploration (ISGE)}, which introduces a guidance handoff: as the return signal collapses, scarcity subsequently takes over as an exploratory signal to elevate the SNR above a critical threshold. Specifically, ISGE iteratively alternates between a \emph{Judger} that assigns scarcity scores to trajectories and an \emph{Explorer} that performs guided generation of high-scarcity and high-return trajectories, thereby bootstrapping from the narrow support with such self-generated trajectories. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Interference Bounds and Merge-Aware Training Dynamics for Composable Fine-Tuned Models

Combining fine-tuned models by composing their parameter updates has become a standard alternative to multi-task training. We formalize composability as a property of a collection of task vectors and prove that the excess loss of the merged model is controlled by an interference functional of the cross-task curvature overlap and the signed alignment of the updates. In the quadratic regime this functional equals the excess loss, giving a criterion that is necessary as well as sufficient and that measures the angle between task vectors in the curvature metric rather than the Euclidean one. Fine-tuning under a curvature-guided regularizer -- constructed from curvature statistics of the kind memory-efficient optimizers maintain -- keeps displacement in the base curvature metric below a ceiling set by the penalty coefficient at every iterate, at the standard $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ non-convex rate. Under a single Loewner comparison between the base statistic and the task curvatures, this control converts into a ceiling on the interference functional, inversely proportional to the penalty coefficient, so that the curvature term of the bound is controlled during training. item.title: How Reliable Are Explanations of Language Models That Detect Insider Threats?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

How Reliable Are Explanations of Language Models That Detect Insider Threats?

Organizations monitor their workers' activity for insider threats, in which workers misuse their legitimate access, by copying confidential files before leaving. Detectors score how unusual each day of activity is, flagging the most unusual for an analyst to review. Prominent current approaches use opaque neural networks, so explanations of a flag point to internal features: patterns of neuron activity most active on days of misuse. We audit such explanations for language-model detectors trained on CERT's simulated workplace logs. To test an explanation, we see what happens to the detector's score when we remove its features inside the model. We compare this to a control: a change that is as similar as possible to the removal, but without actually removing the features. Because defining "similar" requires choosing a metric, our central contribution is the tipping radius: a first-order prediction of how far that metric must move before the difference between removal and control disappears, a measure of how fragile the result is to that choice. In 33 of 34 runs of seven language models, the tipping radius is at most 18% of the distance between two standard choices of metric. Moving t…

item.title: HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 注意力用完整点积给每个 query 对每个 key 打分——这个点积必须算完吗？

方法：HiSA（Hidden Sparse Attention）保持 query/key 投影完整、只计算部分点积，按 token 位置确定的静态免参数规则在 hidden（特征）维度上做稀疏——比 token 稀疏更少被探索的轴；基于 RoPE 结构把 key/query 分解出可省略部分；从头训练 LLM，并扩展到 FlashAttention-3 内核。

关键数字：只计算约 1/3 的 query-key 乘积，性能不降反升；推理解码速度提升、内存占用缩小；代码开源。

为什么值得看：开辟 hidden 维度稀疏新轴，训练与推理双受益且无需学习参数。

item.title: Held While Waiting: What LLM Agent Sessions Reserve on Serverless and Agent Runtimes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Held While Waiting: What LLM Agent Sessions Reserve on Serverless and Agent Runtimes

LLM agents spend nearly all their time waiting for the model. On Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, our agents waited a median of 2.7 seconds for each model reply, then computed for an estimated 5 to 40 milliseconds. AgentCore does not charge for CPU during the wait. But it reserves a separate environment, a virtual machine with its own memory, for every conversation, and keeps it reserved until the conversation is closed. So 1,000 conversations reserve 1,000 environments to do the work of 2 to 15 processor cores. A service runs out of environments long before it runs out of processing power. The shortage has two causes, and each has a fix. An environment stays reserved after its conversation ends: in the customer-service benchmark we ran, a conversation lasts 33 seconds on average, but its environment is held for 15 minutes more unless the client closes it. And an environment serves only one conversation, which is mostly waiting: in our simulation, 64 conversations sharing one environment need 59 times fewer environments, and 99 of every 100 replies are delayed by at most 40 milliseconds. The milliseconds are an estimate because they are hard to measure: a stubbed model, a timer around the…

item.title: Graph-XGB: A Hybrid GNN Framework for Outdoor-to-Indoor 5G Signal Reconstruction via Aerial-Only UAV RF Sensing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Graph-XGB：无人机射频感知的室外到室内 5G 信号重建

Delivering robust In-Building Coverage (IBC) is critically impeded by severe Outdoor-to-Indoor (O2I) attenuation, a constraint that intensifies as deployments move from 5G mid-band towards mmWave and prospective 6G sub-THz carriers, where losses of 60-80 dB have been reported across modern building envelopes. While Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) offer scalable exterior RF sensing platforms, a fundamental inversion problem persists: interior 3D signal states cannot be directly sampled from constrained exterior flight paths. This paper proposes Graph-XGB, a hybrid inference framework that decouples spatial topology reasoning from non-linear signal regression to resolve this challenge. A modified SpiderGNN encoder, operating on a topology-aware graph constructed with a physically grounded Floor-Aware 3D Distance metric and Bridge Edge Guarantees, propagates UAV boundary measurements into 128-dimensional indoor embeddings. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) compresses these into a 10-dimensional manifold retaining 96.6% of embedding variance, fused with raw spatial features and decoded by independent, physics-tailored XGBoost regressors. item.title: Goal-Guided Reinforcement Learning via Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Goal-Guided Reinforcement Learning via Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Models

Exploration remains a major challenge for reinforcement learning (RL) agents in Craftax-style environments due to sparse rewards and long horizons. Large language models (LLMs) can guide exploration by generating high-level goals, but methods using models without explicit task adaptation often rely on carefully designed prompts and may produce inconsistent or contextually inappropriate goals. We introduce CCGP-2M, a multimodal goal-preference dataset constructed from interaction trajectories in Craftax-Classic, and propose a vision-language model (VLM)-guided RL framework that learns environment-specific goal guidance from this dataset. The framework consists of two stages: offline VLM fine-tuning and online goal-guided RL. In the offline stage, we align the VLM with goal preferences using Kullback-Leibler Token-level Direct Preference Optimization (KLTDPO), which combines token-level KL regularization with distributionally robust reweighting. Experiments on Craftax-Classic show that our method collects diamonds earlier than state-of-the-art baselines, achieves the highest score and reward, and attains the highest success rates on most achievements.

item.title: GRODE-RTL: Source-Mapped Dependency Views for LLM-Based RTL Repair
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 自动 RTL 修复在非局部故障（根因与失败输出在源码中相距很远）上表现挣扎；把 RTL 当扁平 token 序列会遮蔽硬件数据流，暴露完整综合图又让模型淹没在细粒度元数据里。

方法：GRODE-RTL 是 anchor-centric 表示：从网表提取嫌疑寄存器的单时钟级 fan-in cone，把网表节点映射回可编辑源码行，组织成紧凑的 hop 分区依赖视图；优先直接驱动、折叠远跳，引导标准 tool-using agent。

关键数字：30 个经正式验证的非局部故障 × 3 个 LLM，pass@1 相对源码级探索提升 DeepSeek 16.7%、GLM-5.2 26.7%、MiniMax-M3 20.0%；远距离与间接 anchor 子集一致增益；消融证明选择性依赖组织而非全图暴露是关键。

为什么值得看：给 LLM RTL 修复一个信息密度恰当的表示，非局部故障修复显著变好。

item.title: FrontierReplay: Split-Free Exact Prefix Caching for Hybrid Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：混合 LM 的循环层 in-place 状态更新把前缀复用限制在精确保存位置；粗网格保存浪费可复用前缀，细粒度精确缓存又须在中间 checkpoint 切断 prefill、增加调度开销。

方法：观察到多轮对话、agent 循环、文档问答与树搜索中前缀复用几乎总在可预测的结构边界（轮次结束、已知分支点）结束；FrontierReplay 在这些边界物化精确 checkpoint 而不切断 prefill——前向不截断时记录短窗口循环层输入，跨层 state-only replay 内核构建目标状态。

关键数字：replay 每 token 比完整重算便宜 6–37× 且无 host 同步；中位 TTFT 降 16–89%（最高 8.9×），80% SLO 容量最高提升 1.73×，goodput 最高提升 4.26×（大规模 3.67×）；相对近似 replay 方法 goodput 高至 1.54× 且保持精确任务准确率（近似方法长上下文最多掉 17% 准确率）。

为什么值得看：混合 LM 精确前缀缓存的优雅解法，免切断 prefill 且收益显著。

item.title: From Sequence Uncertainty to Phenotype Hypotheses: Uncertainty-Conditioned Inference over Biomedical Knowledge Graphs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

From Sequence Uncertainty to Phenotype Hypotheses: Uncertainty-Conditioned Inference over Biomedical Knowledge Graphs

Genomic foundation models provide variant-level evidence, but connecting that evidence to phenotype hypotheses requires accounting for uncertainty throughout structured reasoning. We introduce an uncertainty-conditioned path-energy framework that converts sequence predictions and calibrated predictive uncertainty into explicit distributions over graph-supported phenotype hypotheses, without patient-level phenotype supervision. An interpretable learned energy scores admissible gene--disease--phenotype routes, query uncertainty controls the target temperature, and path probabilities are aggregated into phenotype hypotheses. This formulation makes evidence quality an explicit determinant of hypothesis breadth while retaining traceable multi-path support. Exact normalization over enumerable candidate sets provides a reference for evaluating a Hastings-corrected learned revision operator. On AlzKB and Hetionet, phenotype-level entropy tracks upstream uncertainty, with Spearman correlations of 0.951 and 0.878, respectively; ablations identify the contribution of uncertainty conditioning. In masked-edge recovery, the model exceeds chance and degree-matched probability-permutation controls…

item.title: From Seed to BLOOM: Autonomously Growing a Better Out-of-Order Core
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：提升乱序核性能同时满足 ASIC 面积/频率约束极为劳动密集，需要架构、RTL、性能分析多领域专家，小团队难以承担。

方法：MiracleGro 是 agentic 系统，无需人工干预即可分析 cycle-level RTL 行为与综合结果、识别性能瓶颈、把架构想法转成 BOOM（Berkeley Out-of-Order Machine）的 RTL 实现，并综合权衡 cycle-exact 性能、面积与关键路径。

关键数字：自动产出相比人工优化 BOOM 提升 85% IPC、SkyWater 130nm 频率提升 27% 的设计；完整 SPEC CPU2017 intspeed 墙钟时间加速 2.34×（30 万亿指令）。

为什么值得看：前沿模型端到端优化 RTL 处理平台，实现级微架构研究的范式转变。

item.title: From Data Alignment to Parameter Generation: Few-Shot Cross-City Traffic Prediction with Conditional Diffusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

From Data Alignment to Parameter Generation: Few-Shot Cross-City Traffic Prediction with Conditional Diffusion

Accurate mobile traffic forecasting is crucial for network service management, supporting proactive capacity provisioning, congestion mitigation, and energy-efficient operation. However, many cities and regions are data-scarce (e.g., newly deployed or poorly instrumented areas), thus making traffic prediction a few-shot learning problem and limiting the practicality of standard data-driven models. Existing cross-city solutions primarily rely on data-space alignment to match traffic distributions between data-rich and data-scarce cities, but such alignment is often brittle under real-world distribution shifts, measurement noise, and city-specific bias. To address these limitations, we propose a Conditional Diffusion-based Parameter Generation (CDPG) framework. Instead of aligning raw data, CDPG learns the conditional distribution of high-performing predictor parameters for source cities and directly generates node-specific model parameters for the target city. To support reliable adaptation for network traffic prediction, CDPG conditions parameter generation on multi-modal spatio-temporal context. item.title: From Benchmarks to the Bench: Preference, Correspondence and Selectivity in Bidirectional Drug-Target Screening
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

From Benchmarks to the Bench: Preference, Correspondence and Selectivity in Bidirectional Drug-Target Screening

Identifying active molecules for known targets and potential targets for existing drugs is central to drug discovery and repurposing. Drug-target interaction (DTI) models can rank vast numbers of drug-target pairs, but limited experimental capacity restricts testing to a small number of candidates. We compared the bidirectional recommendations of 13 released systems across 711 molecular structures of FDA-approved drugs and 614 human proteins. For the same target or drug, pairs of models produced completely disjoint Top-10 molecule and protein lists in 77.8% and 70.1% of comparisons, respectively. Even where recommendations overlapped, agreement between some systems largely reflected recurring preferences for the same candidates. Published inhibition measurements for 79 molecules and 65 kinases revealed that some systems enriched active candidates, yet their hit yields changed little when recommendations were matched to different drugs or targets, whereas other systems lost substantially more hits. Some of the former systems also rarely ranked both molecules and kinases correctly when two drugs favoured different kinases. We further retrained the same architecture on the same data, …

item.title: FoldSim: Scaling Cycle-Exact RTL Simulation with Hierarchical Folding and Static Scheduling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：RTL 仿真时间随设计规模快速增长；CPU/GPU 仿真吞吐受限，FPGA 仿真吞吐高但可扩展性受资源容量约束。

方法：FoldSim 自动框架在单块 FPGA 上做 cycle-exact 仿真：层级折叠把设计层次中的实例映射到共享逻辑、保持独立状态；编译器对可折叠模块类构造静态调度，降低动态同步开销、状态访问可预测；超容量状态放外部内存按需取回；可配置 DRAM 模型分离目标内存时序与 host 延迟。

关键数字：单块 AMD Alveo V80 跑 8-SM GPU 与 1024 节点 Rocket 数据中心（4096 核）；非折叠实现分别需约 16×/200× LUT；数据中心约 1.9GB 状态驻留 HBM；4-SM GPU 完成 1024×1024 GEMM 仅 4.24 秒（软件 RTL 仿真 26 小时）。

为什么值得看：把超大设计的 cycle-exact 仿真压进单块 FPGA，吞吐跨数量级提升。

item.title: FlashX: Scaling Robotic Experience Reuse for Embodied Agents with CBA-Based NAND Flash
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：具身 agent 的 VLA/WAM 模型难泛化到 OOD 环境；检索成功经验做 warm-start 降噪可同时提升准确率与推理效率，但经验库扩展带来边缘系统难承受的存储与搜索开销。

方法：FlashX 是 CBA（CMOS Directly Bonded to Array）NAND flash 架构：借 CBA 高内部带宽做并行 pSLC key 搜索，交错 Compute-in-Flash（CIF）引擎维持感知吞吐、保留密集 TLC latent 存储；本体感知聚类降搜索开销并支持增量经验获取、免全局重聚类。

关键数字：VLA/WAM 任务成功率在密集/计算高效配置下分别最高提升 12.24%p/7.43%p；搜索吞吐为最强 prior NAND 搜索架构的 2.57×，聚类再降 9.7× 搜索；相对 SSD 检索端到端加速 1.29–3.95×、能效提升 1.12–2.34×。

为什么值得看：存储级方案化解具身 agent 经验复用的扩展瓶颈，精度与效率双赢。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

FG-GraphBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Fine-Grained Visual Understanding with Multimodal Scene Graphs

Fine-grained visual understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to recognize small visual entities and understand their relationships. Scene graphs offer a natural way to represent this information, organizing visual entities as nodes and their relationships as edges. However, we identify two challenges: existing scene graph benchmarks provide insufficient coverage of fine-grained entities and the relationships among them, and existing methods for fine-grained visual understanding have yet to effectively leverage such graph-structured information in MLLMs. To address these challenges, we introduce Fine-Grained Multimodal Scene Graph Benchmark (FG-GraphBench) and FiGRA. FG-GraphBench is a benchmark comprising three complementary tasks: fine-grained visual question answering (FG-QA), image captioning (FG-Caption), and image description generation (FG-Description). We develop a two-stage construction pipeline that discovers and grounds fine-grained entities and establishes their relations to construct the fine-grained multimodal scene graphs (MSGs) in FG-GraphBench. Building on these MSGs, we propose FiGRA, a Fine-grained Graph Representation Augmentation method fo…

FEA solver integration of a composite World Model with a Spiking Neural Network memory Block for computationally efficient modelling of defects and variabilities

Each fibre-reinforced composite structure has a unique material architecture. The manufacturing methods used and the presence of defects lead to local variations which require material-scale models that can resolve the response in real time at every location in the structure. Concurrent multi-scale schemes provide this capability, but at a prohibitive computational cost for large structures as the number of integration points and time increments scales with size. Surrogates have been studied extensively as replacements for material-scale models to mitigate these computational limitations. A surrogate must represent an arbitrary local architecture including defects, track the irreversible material state over an unknown number of increments, remain stable when driven recursively by its own predictions, and fit within the memory available at every integration point. Here, a Composites World Model based on a Multi-Modal Spiking Transformer architecture is designed to meet these requirements. The proposed architecture combines a material encoder, a Spiking Neural Network memory block that tracks the long-term internal state of the material, and transformer blocks that learn the short-te…

item.title: Evidence from a Multi-Regime Causal Discovery Benchmark: UCMT Algorithms, Comparative Performance, and Controlled Ablation Studies
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Evidence from a Multi-Regime Causal Discovery Benchmark: UCMT Algorithms, Comparative Performance, and Controlled Ablation Studies

We present an internal, pre-registered evaluation of the UCMT causal discovery algorithm family alongside established alternatives across heterogeneous benchmark regimes, complemented by a separately pre-registered, controlled study of UCMT v2 Global components. The contribution is both empirical and methodological: a family-stratified comparison of three actively developed algorithm configurations and targeted evidence about which internal stages affect their outcomes. item.title: Don't Discard Your Rollouts: Reusing Teacher RL Traces for Student Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

复用教师 RL rollouts 做学生蒸馏的数据选择方法

RL post-training methods such as PPO and GRPO are computationally expensive, with substantial resources devoted to sampling rollouts, which contain multiple completions per prompt along with their respective rewards. Canonical distillation, however, discards these traces and uses more compute to regenerate data from the final teacher. We ask if and how we can reuse the saved teacher RL rollouts to distil student models. Reusing rollouts is non-trivial: naive SFT on the rollouts underperforms canonical distillation, and naive DPO, while performant, is unstable, collapsing on weaker students. We show that treating rollout reuse as a data selection problem using metadata already recorded during GRPO substantially reduces this gap. We use prompt pass rates to order the data, using the easiest prompts for an SFT warm start prior to using mixed-success prompts for DPO. For each prompt, we use saved teacher log-likelihoods as a proxy for selecting student-compatible completions. Across mathematical reasoning and Python coding tasks, with students from multiple model families, our two-stage recipe achieves comparable average performance to canonical distillation, while incurring no additio…

item.title: Does the Workspace Do the Work? A Causal Protocol for Verifying Global-Workspace Computation in a Language Model
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Does the Workspace Do the Work? A Causal Protocol for Verifying Global-Workspace Computation in a Language Model

Global Workspace Theory (GWT), a leading theory of consciousness, holds that information becomes conscious when it is broadcast to specialized processes that use it. Building a workspace into a network does not reveal what the trained network computes with it: a module that reports an answer may have combined a broadcast message with its own knowledge, or merely forwarded an answer computed elsewhere, and task accuracy and ablation cannot tell these apart. We introduce a causal protocol that identifies who computes when modules communicate. Its central test transplants a message from another input, chosen so that ignoring, relaying and recombining it predict three different answers. On networks built to relay or to recombine, the test assigns the right computation in every case. Among trained workspace models it finds all three outcomes: one leaves its broadcast nearly unused, and of two models that differ only in their training data, one relays and the other recombines. In AFGW, a language model whose modules communicate only through a learned workspace, a transplanted message yields the answer that recombination predicts in 97% of cases, and its content acts by redirecting what t…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Disentangling Monitor Hardware Artifacts and Smoothing Lag for Shift-Robust Intraoperative EEG and Hemodynamic Risk Calibration

Commercial intraoperative electroencephalography (EEG) and blood pressure monitors introduce cyclic impedance pulses, smoothing delays, direct-current (DC) drift, and cuff holds that confound risk forecasting and uncertainty calibration. We developed a causal signal-conditioning and shift-robust conformal calibration framework across 5,439 public anesthesia procedures. Streaming filters blank 10.13-min 64-Hz impedance checks, apply unclipped post-notch conditioning, separate 63-s suppression-ratio lag, and distinguish three-channel cuff inflations from dropouts across propofol-remifentanil total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA; N = 3,214), volatile anesthesia (N = 2,046), European endoscopy sedation (N = 171), and DC-coupled surgery (N = 8). De-impedanced cortical tree ensembles were compared against deep sequence models, paired with patient-cluster Subgroup-Covariate-Weighted Conformal Risk Control (CRC) and lag-buffered online Conformal Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) tracking. Pre-filter blanking removed 97.90% and 97.60% of false flatline conflicts while preserving 99.23% and 98.96% of deep suppression. item.title: Dimension-Free Buffer Bounds for Compressed-Momentum Error Feedback
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Dimension-Free Buffer Bounds for Compressed-Momentum Error Feedback

Analyses of error feedback bound the memory buffer through a compressor contraction constant -- $r/p$ for the best rank-$r$ approximation of a $p$-dimensional spectrum -- which survives into the rate. We show it need not appear at all. When the compressed momentum is re-injected into the pre-compression accumulator, the previous compressed momentum $β_1 M_{t-1}$ is an admissible competitor in the projection, and the buffer obeys $\|E_t\|_F \le (1-β_1)\|G_t\|_F + γ\|E_{t-1}\|_F$, free of the dimensions $m,n$ and of the rank $r$. The argument uses only that the compressor is a metric projection onto a closed cone, so it covers top-$k$ selection as well as truncated SVD, holds for every selection from the projection set with no condition on singular-value crossings, and in its trajectory-tracking form assumes nothing about the gradients. In the two-stage template of the standard analyses it replaces a Stage-2 constant of order $p^2/r^2$ by one of order $1$, against $Θ(p/r)$ for the sharpest contraction-based bounds. item.title: Depth-Linked Residual Tokens for Multimodal Retrieval and Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

DepThink：深度链接残差令牌用于多模态检索与生成

Iterative architectures such as looped language models improve parameter efficiency and reasoning capacity of transformers, yet their sequential backbone iterations introduce substantial computational latency. Conversely, parallelizable learnable special tokens (such as the register tokens in Vision Transformer) enable efficient single-pass inference, but often suffer from the absence of sequential refinement and exhibit redundant representations across tokens. To address these challenges, we introduce Depth-Linked Residual Tokens (DepThink), an efficient framework designed for multimodal retrieval and generation. Operating within a single pre-filling forward pass, DepThink appends a sequence of K learnable residual tokens whose hidden states are coupled through a lightweight, learnable residual recurrence. This mechanism enables each residual token to progressively capture complementary information missed by preceding tokens. Theoretically, we prove that DepThink provides strictly expanded geometric directional reachability over standard learnable tokens and guarantees a provable one-step descent advantage. We evaluate DepThink across multimodal retrieval and generation tasks. Dep…

item.title: Decision-Focused Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Decision-Focused Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-Training

Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise as predictors across various tasks, benefiting from their ability to use information from unstructured context. However, when predictions serve as parameters of downstream optimization problems, higher prediction accuracy does not necessarily translate into lower decision costs. We propose decision-focused reinforcement learning (DFRL), a framework for post-training LLMs to predict optimization parameters using negative downstream decision regret as reward. DFRL trains LLM predictors to minimize the costs of the decisions induced by their predictions, without requiring downstream convexity or differentiability, and integrates readily into existing RL post-training frameworks. To address expensive reward evaluation, we develop two approaches. Heuristic warm-starting uses inexpensive approximate rewards during an initial phase before switching to refinement with exact rewards. Reward correction combines inexpensive estimates with randomized exact evaluations, preserving the expected policy gradient while reducing the expected number of exact solves per update. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 处理长文档/代码库使长上下文注意力成为 prefill 主要瓶颈；块稀疏注意力跳过不重要的注意力块，但准确给块打分本身很贵。

方法：DTS 训练-free、内容自适应的 tile 打分：按局部向量变化选 query/key anchor，冗余区域用更少代表、异构区域保留更多细节；并行 delta packing 把序列切成 tile 对齐块做有界局部扫描加速 anchor 选择；选中 tile 用原始 query/key/value 计算。

关键数字：LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct 上平均 RULER/LongBench 与全注意力相差 0.10 个百分点内（RULER 到 128K）；128K 打分流水线延迟比 XAttention 低 38%；4×H100 上 512K tokens prefill 相对 PyTorch+FlashAttention-2 全注意力快 3.3×。

为什么值得看：免训练内容自适应打分，长上下文 prefill 提速显著且精度几乎无损。

item.title: Cross-Attack Robust Aggregation for Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

FedTether：跨攻击鲁棒聚合的联邦学习

Federated learning (FL) lets resource-constrained IoT and edge devices train a shared model without exchanging raw data, but compromised or faulty devices can poison the global model. Existing robust aggregators each fail in some regime: naive averaging (FedAvg) collapses under high-magnitude attacks, whereas distance- and statistics-based defenses (Krum, median, trimmed mean) sacrifice accuracy on non-IID data and remain vulnerable to stealthy attacks. We present FedTether, which reweights client updates by their deviation from a coordinatewise median through a robust, dead-zoned score applied as a server-side optimizer step. Across three datasets, three attack types, and Byzantine fractions up to 40%, FedTether is the only method top-tier in every regime: it matches FedAvg under stealthy attacks with no robustness tax, exceeds robust baselines by up to 42 accuracy points, and stays accurate where high-magnitude attacks reduce FedAvg to near-random. These properties persist at 50 clients under partial participation, with no shared data or validation set.

item.description:

Coordinate Basis Linear Bandits with Sublinear Regret over Low-Rank Clusters

We study the problem of computational efficiency for linear bandits in high-dimensional settings with a finite arm set. In linear bandits, the increase in the dimension $d$ of the feature vectors leads to growing computational costs of $O(d^2)$ at each round of update. Traditional low-rank approximation methods such as SOFUL reduce computation via fixed-size matrix sketching, yet run the risk of incurring vacuous linear regret when the spectral tail of the data is heavy and the approximation rank is inadequately selected. To guarantee regret convergence and effectively reduce computational costs, we introduce a clustering mechanism and propose the Coordinate Basis Linear Bandit (CBL) algorithm. Our method preserves the full covariance information in each cluster by maintaining an exact orthonormal basis of the cluster's column space together with a low-dimensional coordinate representation, which guarantees robust sublinear regret without spectral-tail vulnerabilities. Cooling Noisy Population Protocols -- Vanishing-Gain Averaging and Localisation under Persistent Errors

We study noise-tolerant coordination in anonymous population protocols whose agents interact in uniformly random pairs, maintain real-valued labels, and have no global clock. Each agent cools its updates using a gain $γ_k=(k+1)^{-p}$ computed from its own local interaction counter. First, for pairwise averaging with independent communication errors drawn from a fixed centred finite-variance distribution, we prove convergence with probability 1 to a common finite random value for every $1/2<p\le1$, and derive convergence-rate exponents under the same assumptions. Second, for one-dimensional localisation with fixed non-degenerate Gaussian displacement errors, we show that the one-sided RightAlign rule rectifies centred noise and cannot stabilise; a signed update based on the relative-position discrepancy restores convergence to the true agents locations up to one finite random translation. Third, we analyse the setting in which both communication errors and displacement-measurement errors depend on the physical distance between the interacting devices. 研究问题：并发 kernel 执行是 AI/ML 训练与推理的普遍范式，但并发 kernel 争用 GPU 共享资源（核心、缓存、内存带宽）会造成性能下降——到底降多少、如何缓解？

方法：首次大规模特征化并发 kernel 执行：在 AMD MI300X 上用毫秒级采样器做性能与内存行为分析，沿内存/计算受限、大/小 kernel 两个维度给出减速洞察；据此提出 CAFEML 弹性执行，用简单启发式调并发 kernel 的 overlap anchor 与资源分配。

关键数字：仅调度改动、无需 kernel 重写，端到端最高 13% 加速。

为什么值得看：并发争用的系统性特征化 + 零成本调度优化，训练/推理场景通用。

原文：Contention-Aware Flexible Execution for Machine Learning Workloads

item.title: Complete-SVD: A Functional Norm Approach to Low-Rank LLM Compression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：训练后低秩压缩既要近似权重、更要保持模型输入-输出行为；现有 output-aware 方法按观测 next token 或模型预测概率加权 logit 变化，权重有偏。

方法：Complete-SVD 最小化原始与压缩模型 logits 的 L2 距离、所有 logit 变化等权；线性化 + Kronecker 近似把目标化为带闭式解的加权 SVD；输出侧因子不可解，用随机探针无偏估计（每条序列 K 次反向传播，与词表大小和序列长度无关）；另评估 KL 变体（KL-SVD）。

关键数字：均匀秩 + WikiText-2 校准下 C4/PTB 困惑度全部设置最低，ratio 0.7 LEMS 分配下同样最低；KL-SVD 多数设置校准困惑度更低、下游准确率更高但跨语料困惑度升高；IFEval 指令跟随准确率全程优于最强 prior output-aware 方法。

为什么值得看：对压缩误差度量的重新思考，闭式解 + 无偏估计兼顾理论与实用。

item.title: CarrierKV: An Edge LLM Accelerator with Positional Carrier Decomposition for Low-Bit KV Cache
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：边缘端长上下文解码受 DRAM 限制，因为每生成一个 token 都要读整个不断增长的 KV cache；4-bit 块缩放格式（如 NVFP4）降低流量但掉精度。

方法：发现 key 的大部分能量是「位置载体」（RoPE 随位置旋转的单向量），NVFP4 中它设定多数 key block 的共享 scale、把内容信噪比压低约 5dB；据此提出位置载体分解：RoPE 前移除载体、只存内容残差，直接对 4-bit 码算注意力分数，另设计位置相位引擎逐周期再生成载体的分数项。

关键数字：同 cache 大小下 Qwen3-4B 32K RULER 从 79.4 提到 91.1（FP8 key 为 89.3），32K PG19 困惑度增幅降 1.8~5.9 倍；硬件面积仅增 2.9%、每 token 能量省 13.7%。

为什么值得看：低比特 KV cache 精度-体积权衡的系统性解法，硬件开销极小。

原文：CarrierKV: An Edge LLM Accelerator with Positional Carrier Decomposition for Low-Bit KV Cache

item.title: CRAFT: Analog Circuit Design by Reasoning LLM Agents from Pre-Computed Lookup Tables
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

CRAFT: Analog Circuit Design by Reasoning LLM Agents from Pre-Computed Lookup Tables

Automated analog circuit sizing methods, from black-box optimizers to recent large language model (LLM) agents, typically search the design space with a SPICE simulator in the loop, whereas an experienced designer works out a design by hand analysis. This paper presents CRAFT, a flow in which an LLM agent designs a given topology by calculation, as a designer does, and without an initial sizing. The agent works only through DeX, a service that uses pre-computed lookup tables to provide device characteristics and to solve the whole netlist for its operating point and small-signal response. It thus designs without SPICE, and every final design is verified independently in HSPICE. We test CRAFT on four circuits in a commercial 28 nm process; the largest is a 37-transistor three-stage amplifier with 53 design variables, 20 specifications and 74 saturation constraints. With Claude Opus 5.5, CRAFT meets every specification and constraint in all 20 runs, five per circuit. On that amplifier, with DeX in place of HSPICE and an identical request for both, the same agent passes in 10 of 10 runs instead of 6 of 10 within an hour and is 2.0x faster at the median.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: BOOMerang: Autonomous Translation from RTL to Microarchitectural Simulators and Back
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：gem5 等高级模拟器缺乏对硬件可实现性的反馈、常与真实设计性能脱节；手工把模拟器代码转高质量 RTL 又需要大团队。

方法：BOOMerang 构建 agentic loops 自动化双向转换：(1) 自动为 BOOM 核在 gem5 生成对齐的高层模型；(2) 把模拟器中的新微架构特性忠实转回 RTL。

关键数字：生成的 gem5 模型 IPC 与 RTL 相差 3% 以内（仅 2 天）；自动把 72 个特性转回 BOOM RTL 且保持低 IPC 误差；组合优化使 BOOM RTL 在 SPECint 2017 性能提升 25%；产物开源。

为什么值得看：模拟器与 RTL 双向自动对齐，让小型团队也能做实现级微架构研究。

item.title: Attention Head Specialization: Phase Transitions in Sample Complexity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Attention Head Specialization: Phase Transitions in Sample Complexity

Attention heads specialize into distinct functions during training, often emerging in stages together with sharp changes in model behavior. While this phenomenon has mostly been studied as a function of training time, we ask how head specialization depends on the amount of available training data. Empirically, we find that heads specialized to syntactic relations in BERT emerge as the dataset size increases. We then study this phenomenon in a solvable high-dimensional model of multi-head attention and establish that, in this model, head specialization is a genuine phase transition in sample complexity, corresponding to a non-analyticity in the test error and other observables. Depending on data structure and regularization, specialization can follow uninformative head differentiation or occur through a cascade of phase transitions that progressively recover weaker latent features, providing a statistical form of simplicity bias. Finally, we relate these statistical transitions to the stagewise emergence of specialized heads during online learning, disentangling statistical from dynamical origins of head specialization.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：长上下文解码反复读取增长的 KV cache，FP4 可减存储与流量但需 block scaling 应对有限动态范围；用于 MLA 时须在共享 latent 上调和 K/V 的不同缩放需求，现有反量化或分离编码方案增加执行/存储开销。

item.title: Approximate Adjoint Models for Memory and Compute-Efficient Online Learning of Hybrid Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Approximate Adjoint Models for Memory and Compute-Efficient Online Learning of Hybrid Models

Differentiable programming enables online calibration of numerical models by minimizing errors accumulated along simulated trajectories. This includes estimating physical parameters and training neural sub-models in hybrid configurations. Gradients are typically computed using adjoint methods, or backpropagation through time (BPTT), whose computational and memory costs grow with the length of the training window. This limits the duration and resolution of hybrid-model training, a major bottleneck for realistic geophysical applications. Approaches like truncated BPTT reduces memory use by discarding sensitivities across truncation boundaries, introducing gradient bias and neglecting long-range dependencies. We propose a class of gradient approximation methods that preserve the adjoint recurrence over the full trajectory while approximating only the pullback operators within it. Exact pullbacks are computed by automatic differentiation at sparse anchor states only. Between anchors, sensitivities propagate either through the identity (Zero-order) or through a reused, frozen pullback (Pullback Reuse). item.title: Antom 3-in-1 Transformer: A Payment Foundation Model
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Antom 3-in-1 Transformer: A Payment Foundation Model

We report the development of Antom 3-in-1 Transformer, a payment foundation model that integrates sequence, tabular, and graph representations for payment risk detection. The model contains approximately 7B parameters, with approximately 1.7B activated per task route. Antom 3-in-1 Transformer is pretrained to learn reusable behavioral and relational representations, primarily on Ant International's internal payment data. In a cross-business transfer experiment, pretraining improves the target business metric by 34.5% over the same architecture trained from scratch. With only 25% of the training labels, the pretrained model outperforms the full-label scratch baseline in Average Precision (AP) and Recall@0.5% on different merchant domains. In a four-month online experiment on Ant International's billion-scale payment platform, the model reduced the overall loss rate by 37.88% relative to XGB-Online.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Aggron: Aggressive Compression of Agentic KV Caches during Head-of-Line Stalls in the Request Queue
item.description:

方法：Aggron 每轮总结 agentic 请求、只选择性压缩部分 KV cache，保持精度并让总结轻量；从独立 Summarization Queue 发起总结，利用主队列 head-of-line 停滞留下的算力/内存余量；仅当预测总结能在对应请求最终执行前完成时才发出。

关键数字：高负载下相对 SOTA 异步总结，P99 程序延迟降低 27–31%，吞吐提升 1.34–1.40×。

为什么值得看：把 KV 压缩塞进 HOL 停滞的空闲窗口，近乎零额外竞争。

item.title: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher

Acquiring every feature of an instance is often costly: a measurement can carry a monetary price, a time delay, or a privacy cost. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses this by learning a policy that decides, per instance, which features to acquire under a budget. Existing AFA methods train this policy by optimizing a self-constructed utility target rather than distilling an explicit teacher. We construct this teacher explicitly. At training time the label and the unobserved feature values are available, and together they determine the teacher in closed form: an oracle that ranks every candidate by its effect on the downstream predictor's error. OracleImitator distills this ranking into a deployable policy by soft-target imitation. Across multimodal medical diagnosis and the AFABench benchmark, OracleImitator matches or outperforms existing AFA methods across the budget range, recovering 90% of the attainable accuracy gain at under a quarter of the acquisition cost. Because the teacher is an explicit algorithmic object rather than an implicit optimization target, we can also measure directly how much of its ranking is recoverable by a policy restricted to what is visible at de…

item.title: Accelerating Mixture of Block Attention via Dynamic Routing, KV-Centric Execution and Runtime Pipelining
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：MoBA（Mixture of Block Attention）按查询选 KV 块降长上下文算量，但 FlashMoBA 固定 Top-k 预算与 query-centric 调度：一个预算套不同分数分布、query-range 所有权碎片化 K/V 复用。

方法：LightningMoBA 协同设计选择与执行：动态路由阈值化每查询块分数、直接产出可变基数稀疏元数据；KV-centric ownership 按 (query head, KV block) 列分组、拆分高扇出列为有界任务并复用已加载 KV tile；Hopper 上运行时流水线重叠 K/V 传输与 Tensor Core 计算。

关键数字：匹配 Top-16 保留下五个 checkpoint 端到端生成加速 1.20–1.60×，平均 RULER 分数从 74.42 升至 75.28。

为什么值得看：MoBA 从路由到执行的系统级协同优化，保留率不降反升。

item.title: A Sparsity Analysis of Traffic Forecasting Architectures: How Much Missing Data is Too Much?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

交通预测架构对传感器缺失数据的稀疏性分析

Traffic forecasting models are typically evaluated under ideal conditions with complete data. This evaluation does not reflect the frequent sensor failures and communication outages common in real-world deployments. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of multivariate traffic prediction models to evaluate their performance under varying levels of sensor data loss during inference. We benchmark several architectural paradigms, including graph neural networks, attention-based Transformers, and selective state-space models, across sparsity levels ranging from zero to complete sensor loss, using two widely used multi-channel traffic benchmarks. To ensure consistent comparison across traffic variables, we use normalized metrics and define a usability threshold to identify when predictions become unreliable. Our results show a clear trade-off between baseline accuracy and robustness: models with the highest accuracy under full-data conditions often degrade most sharply as data becomes sparse, while less accurate models maintain more stable performance. These findings show that model selection should be based on the expected reliability of the sensor network rather than peak accur…

item.title: A Sparse Low-Rank Biclique Decomposition for Graphs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

A Sparse Low-Rank Biclique Decomposition for Graphs

Low-rank plus sparse decompositions, such as robust PCA, typically model the low-rank component as dense and the sparse component as corruption. This viewpoint is poorly suited to graph adjacency matrices, where sparsity is structural and dense low-rank factors destroy the combinatorial and computational properties of the graph. We propose signed biclique decomposition (SBD), a sparse low-rank decomposition for integer-weighted graphs that represents the structured component as a sum of sparse signed binary rank-one factors, together with a sparse signed residual. The resulting representation remains discrete, interpretable, sparse, and compatible with standard linear algebra. We formulate fixed-rank and greedy SBD objectives and derive a gain-based greedy algorithm with theoretical guarantees. Empirically, SBD recovers block structure in noisy graphs, while its factorized representation enables efficient sparse matrix-matrix multiplication (SpMM). On real graphs with strong shared-neighborhood structure, SBD achieves compression factors above $10$ and SpMM speedups up to $6\times$ over cuSPARSE, suggesting a practical alternative to dense low-rank decompositions for graphs. item.title: A Lightweight Hybrid Approach for Milling Force Reconstruction from Internal Machine Signals
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-19　分类：论文PDF

A Lightweight Hybrid Approach for Milling Force Reconstruction from Internal Machine Signals

Data-driven monitoring based on milling force can enable advanced manufacturing services including process optimization and condition monitoring. However, industrial implementation is often hindered by costly and intrusive hardware and large training data requirements. This paper therefore presents a hybrid approach using machine-internal signals and machining metadata to enable force-based monitoring on brownfield machines without additional sensors. Commonly available machine signals have relatively low sampling rates and cannot directly represent high-frequency milling-force variations, especially at higher spindle speeds. Instead of learning the complete force signal, which would increase model complexity, data requirements, and overfitting risk, a supervised machine-learning model predicts only the average milling force from selected machine-signal features and machining parameters. This low-frequency estimation parameterizes a static milling force model that reconstructs the force behavior over one spindle revolution. Although the static model does not reproduce all dynamic effects, it captures the force distribution, load levels, and angular regions of highest tool engagemen…

item.title: eFAIR: Fair LLM Serving under Hourly Electricity Commitments
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

eFAIR：小时级电力承诺预算下的公平 LLM serving 调度

Datacenters can procure electricity in day-ahead markets by committing to energy purchases for individual hours. For LLM services operating within these hourly budgets, maximizing aggregate throughput alone may still leave individual requests waiting or receiving much slower service than desired. Fair serving therefore requires improving service for poorly served requests while reserving electricity for later arrivals whose timing and demand are unknown. To compare service across requests, we define normalized throughput as each request's actual output rate divided by the product of its standalone throughput and its service entitlement, a positive weight representing its desired service level. Using this measure, we formulate fair serving as leximin optimization under an hourly electricity constraint, prioritizing requests with the lowest normalized throughput. To address this problem, we present eFAIR, an online scheduler that coordinates request dispatching, electricity budget allocation, and GPU frequency selection through a common normalized-throughput target. Specifically, request dispatching prioritizes requests by desired service level and progress; electricity budget alloca…

item.title: Zonotopic Analysis of Quantization Error in Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

神经网络量化误差的 zonotope 抽象解释

Quantized neural networks achieve computational efficiency by reducing precision, but bounding their quantization error remains a challenge due to discrete rounding and clamping operations. We present a zonotope-based abstract interpretation framework for quantized ReLU feed-forward network verification, introducing a unified round-clamp abstract transformer that jointly handles both operations. We extend this framework to constrained zonotopes, which add linear constraints to tighten bounds, and derive sound quantization error representations. We establish soundness and affine-strip optimality of the round-clamp abstract transformer, as well as convex-hull optimality of its complete constrained formulation. On the ACAS Xu benchmarks, our constrained zonotope method reduces average error-bound widths by approximately 70-85% and runtimes by 65-80% compared to QEBVerif's symbolic DRA propagation at the two smallest tested perturbation radii (r=3 and r=6). These improvements are not uniform across bitwidths, and symbolic DRA achieves tighter bounds at larger radii. Our plain zonotope method delivers competitive sound bounds nearly 300 times faster on average.

item.title: What Survival Benchmarks Don't Tell You: Impact of Model Selection and Dataset Regimes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

生存基准未告诉你的事：模型选择与数据集 regime 的影响

Despite the proliferation of survival analysis methods, current benchmarks often operate under narrow conditions: they heavily rely on the concordance index (C-index) for evaluation and model selection, and frequently either exclude deep learning (DL) methods or underrepresent challenging dataset regimes. To address these limitations, we conduct a large-scale, neutral benchmark comparing 10 classical, tree-based, and DL methods across 49 diverse datasets. Crucially, we treat the model selection criterion (optimizing for C-index, Integrated Brier Score (IBS), or Mean Absolute Error (MAE-PO)) as an independent experimental variable. Using Bayesian mixed-effects modeling, we demonstrate that evaluation design heavily dictates conclusions. For complex DL and tree-based architectures, selecting hyperparameters to optimize for IBS instead of C-index yields substantial improvements in probabilistic accuracy and calibration at a negligible cost to discriminative ranking. Furthermore, method performance (C-index, IBS, MAE-PO, and X-CAL) is fundamentally governed by dataset characteristics. While DL models scale exceptionally well with larger sample sizes, they suffer notable performance dro…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

方差最优反事实策略设计：样本高效的在线 A/B 测试

Online A/B testing is the standard approach for evaluating changes to user-facing systems, such as a new recommendation or ranking policy, before deployment. While the difference-in-means estimator of a standard A/B test is unbiased, it often suffers from high variance. When the treatment and production policies choose the same actions with similar probabilities, the resulting observations can add noise while providing little information about the difference between the policies. Consequently, A/B tests can require large amounts of traffic and long durations to detect small treatment effects. Existing variance-reduction methods mainly improve the estimator after the data-collection scheme has been fixed, and recent overlap-aware designs only optimize a single traffic split between the two policies; thereby, they cannot direct traffic to the actions on which the policies disagree. In this paper, we jointly optimize how actions are sampled and how the resulting observations are used to estimate the treatment effect. Our contributions are two-fold. First, building on pairwise off-policy evaluation, we derive the variance-optimal action-level logging policy for estimating the average t…

item.title: VAFL: A Vertical Analytic Federated Learning Mechanism for Efficient Crowdsourced Services via Closed-Form Solutions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

VAFL：垂直解析联邦学习，闭式解的高效众包服务

Intelligent services often rely on complementary information held by different organizations, motivating Vertical Federated Learning without centralized raw-data pooling. We propose VAFL, a Vertical Analytic Federated Learning framework that fits classification and regression heads on fixed local representations through regularized least squares. An agent-assisted protected-computation workflow supports two-party and multi-party collaboration. To reduce fitting overhead, we develop a full-dimensional equivalent solve that applies block factors directly to the target matrix, avoiding construction of the full inverse. We further study two width-reduction strategies: local spectral projection with coefficient lifting, and full-dimensional local fitting with low-rank cross-party correction. The first compresses the prediction space, whereas the second retains local components outside the collaboration subspace. We establish their algebraic properties and analyze their computational scope. Experiments on five benchmarks show the accuracy--cost tradeoffs of these strategies and compatibility with diverse frozen backbones. Predictive performance and training time identify useful operating…

item.title: Twindex: Index Cache Offloading with Coarse-to-Fine Selection for Long-Context Sparse-Attention Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：长上下文解码中主 KV 移到 host 内存后，indexer cache 成为 HBM 瓶颈——在 Qwen 上占单请求 HBM 的 63%、DeepSeek V4.1 上 75%（1M tokens）。

方法：Twindex 在 HBM 只保留紧凑的 indexer cache 副本、完整 cache 放 host；每步副本先选更大候选集，模型自己的 indexer 再从 host 原始行中取 top-k；副本=共享成分+压缩残差（离线学一次），不改模型权重、运行在 CUDA graphs 内。

关键数字：1M tokens 现代 GPU 上比仅 KV offloading 多容纳 1.78×/1.62×/3.03× 请求（Qwen/V4.1/GLM-5.2）；host 不限制批大小时 decode 吞吐达 1.44×/1.25×/2.54×；平均基准分数最多低 3.1%。

为什么值得看：把长上下文稀疏注意力服务的 indexer 瓶颈用粗到细两级选择解开。

item.title: TripleKV: Predict, Prefetch, Protect -- KV Cache Management for AI Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM agent 在推理与工具执行间切换、反复复用增长中的上下文，高并发下 KV cache 工作集可达数百 GiB，被逐出的块在 agent 返回时触发昂贵的重取、阻塞推理。

方法：TripleKV 三层 KV 缓存管理：工具感知延迟预测器预估工具调用完成时间、提前把所需 KV 块从 SSD 预取到 host DRAM（避开稀缺 GPU 内存）；消除 DRAM 中 GPU 驻留块的重复；victim-cache 在块被逐出 GPU 时从 SSD 回填。

关键数字：数据/web/编码 agent 上关键路径 SSD 读取占比从 45–76% 降至 10% 以下；P95 TTFT 相对带 DRAM/SSD 分层的 vLLM 最高降 49%，比近期 agent-aware 系统低 1.5–7×。

为什么值得看：利用 agent 工具执行间隙做预取，把重取延迟藏进空闲窗口。

item.title: Transferring an analysis of human brain organization to language models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

将人脑组织分析迁移到语言模型

During human cortical development, functional systems become increasingly differentiated. We asked whether improved reasoning in language models involves a comparable regional reorganization. Applying diffusion-map embedding, used to characterize cortical organization, to matched base and reasoning-trained models from three families, we found broadly preserved gradient profiles with localized changes within a contiguous layer span. Grafting weights from these spans into instruction-tuned hosts improved mathematical reasoning on average, with gains rising with region overlap, while retaining more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere. Across training, the span formed gradually during the early rise in performance, and grafts from intermediate stages helped. Grafts shifted most hosts partly towards their donors' behaviour and sometimes improved on problems the donors failed; the same analysis located a transferable span in a medical model. Together, these findings identify a reasoning-related region whose weights improve reasoning with low interference in the host's existing mathematical competence.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Toward Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Neural AC Power Flow
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

神经交流潮流模型的分布外泛化

Growing uncertainty in power system operations from renewables integration, extreme weather, and data center loads challenges the reliability of traditional power flow solvers at scale. Machine learning-based proxies are a potentially promising alternative, but the prohibitive cost of generating training data for large grids makes out-of-distribution generalization a key capability for deployment; currently, models trained on small grids lack that capability. In this work, we systematically evaluate how physics-informed losses, multi-grid training, and perturbation-based data augmentation improve the zero-shot transfer of three graph neural network-based power flow models from smaller systems to a larger, unseen 500-bus system. We find that (1) physics-informed losses improve transfer relative to purely supervised objectives; (2) multi-grid training on smaller systems matches the best single grid but does not close the gap to target-grid training; (3) perturbation-based augmentation on edge attributes improves transfer by up to 54.6%; and (4) random line/generator dropout does not consistently improve performance.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: TechReport: Implementing CHERI in gem5
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

TechReport：在 gem5 中实现 CHERI 能力安全模型

Despite countless mitigation efforts, memory safety issues still prevail. The recently discovered security issues in PHP underline this fact. One of the most promising approaches to solving this problem is the concept of Capability Hardware Enhanced RISC Instructions (CHERI). There is a well-developed ecosystem of ISA simulators, compilers, operating systems, and hardware designs that support CHERI. However, the lack of a simulator modeling microarchitectural detail hinders efficient and fast design space exploration for CHERI-enhanced designs means the performance impact of CHERI remains understudied. Therefore, we present gem5-CHERI: a CHERI-enhanced adaptation of the gem5 simulator that can boot the CheriBSD operating system and run custom workloads. The simulator is available open-source on GitHub.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: TangentPDE: Learning Local Operator Responses with Sparse Finite-Difference Supervision
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

TangentPDE：稀疏有限差分监督学习局部算子响应

Neural PDE operators are often optimized through state reconstruction, which largely constrains operator values at observed inputs but does not fully characterize their sensitivity to local perturbations. A more faithful approximation of operator behavior requires not only accurate state predictions, but also correct variations along local perturbation directions. We present TangentPDE, which uses finite differences to approximate directional derivatives and constructs task-relevant finite-step responses from the state outputs of a reference solver at sparse paired inputs. Its objective jointly constrains state fidelity, response-direction alignment, and response-magnitude calibration, thereby learning both operator values and their local variations. Because the response labels are constructed solely from state outputs at paired inputs, the method requires neither explicit derivative labels, linearized or adjoint PDE solves, nor full Jacobians, and remains applicable to nonlinear solvers without derivative interfaces. Building on this, we additionally propose a selectively executed adaptation mechanism to strengthen local operator representations under finite-difference supervision…

item.title: TabBioMed: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Biomedical Tabular Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

TabBioMed：大规模生物医学表格学习基准

Recent advances in machine learning have accelerated biomedical prediction, but evaluation on structured biomedical data remains fragmented, especially for datasets with high dimensionality, large sample size, missingness, and class imbalance. We introduce TabBioMed, a large-scale benchmark of 94 curated public biomedical tabular datasets spanning electronic health records, drug discovery, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, single-cell omics, and systems biology. TabBioMed unifies these datasets through a standardized, dataset-aware preprocessing and evaluation framework, enabling reproducible comparison across classification, regression, and multi-target tasks. We benchmark 23 models across classical baselines, gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular architectures, and tabular foundation models. Foundation models deliver the strongest family-level predictive performance. However, their gains are regime-dependent: tree-based models and tuned multilayer perceptrons remain highly competitive, often dominating under inference-time or training-cost constraints. Overall, TabBioMed shows that biomedical tabular learning is strongly context-dependent, with optimal model c…

item.title: Structure-Preserving Neural Approximation of Convex, Semiconvex, and Quasiconvex Functions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

凸/半凸/拟凸函数的结构保持神经逼近

Input convex neural networks provide a natural way to enforce convexity globally through architectural constraints. We study how this structure-preserving approximation framework extends to semiconvex, quasiconvex, and convex transformable functions. For $C^{1,1}$ convex functions on compact convex domains, we establish the sharp $W^{1,p}$ minimax rate $m^{-1/d}$ under max-affine approximation with $m$ affine pieces, and show that every max-affine function admits an exact bounded-width ICNN representation with complexity linear in $m$. The same $W^{1,p}$ approximation rate extends to semiconvex functions through quadratic lifting and to convex transformable functions through monotone composition. For general Lipschitz quasiconvex functions, we develop a quantitative finite-probe approximation theory based on monotone responses to affine projections and obtain a structure-preserving IqCNN with an $L^\infty$ approximation guarantee. We further show that these approximation results extend to ReLU-transferable smooth activations, including Softplus and ELU. Numerical experiments on PDE-based approximation problems compare the proposed architectures with parameter-matched MLPs and valid…

item.title: Stephen: Verifying Sequencer-Aided Coordination Systems with Cross-View Prophecy
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

验证 sequencer 辅助协调系统：跨视图 prophecy 方法验证 SMR/分布式事务

Many distributed systems achieve high performance by relying on dedicated sequencers to order requests, leaving replicas to commit them in that order. Despite more than a decade of such sequencer-aided coordination (SAC) systems, from Corfu and NOPaxos to LazyLog and SwitchBFT, their correctness has been argued only with pen-and-paper proofs or bounded model checking at the protocol level. In this paper, we formally verify implementations of SAC protocols. The sequencer seems to make this easy: it decides the order of all requests, so the proof can place each request's linearization point at the sequencer using a well-known technique, prophecy variables. Yet a linearization point placed at the sequencer is not durable, because the sequencer orders a request before any replica commits it. Crashes and other rare events may trigger a view change that discards the request, nullifying the earlier decision and the proof that rests on it. Our framework, Stephen, extends prophecy variables to handle view changes, and we make three contributions. (1) We develop cross-view prophecy peek, which lets the proof follow a request across view changes until it is either committed or permanently dis…

item.title: Stealing Exact Training Data from Other Clients during Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

联邦学习中从其他客户端窃取精确训练数据（梯度反演）

Malicious adversaries can employ gradient inversion attacks to reverse-engineer private data using the model updates of a round in Federated Learning. While there have been developments in gradient inversion for text, exact text recovery by a malicious client has so far remained infeasible, as FedAvg entangles the gradient contributions of many clients and obscures the signal of any individual sentence. We introduce a novel attack pipeline that unwinds this entanglement progressively through an iterative loop, in which the gradient contributions of sentences recovered exactly in one round are subtracted from the aggregate, exposing the remaining sentences for recovery in the next iteration. We show, for the first time, exact sentence recovery, with 100% precision, and on aggregates containing up to $4\times$ more tokens than the model's hidden dimension, we recover up to 80.2% of client sentences exactly, a regime where existing attacks recover none exactly.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SplitReAlign: Partition-Aware Representation Realignment for Split Federated Unlearning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

SplitReAlign: Partition-Aware Representation Realignment for Split Federated Unlearning

Split federated learning (SFL) distributes neural networks across clients and a server, coupling class-specific knowledge across their representations. This coupling complicates split federated unlearning (SFU), where class-wise forgetting must remove target knowledge while preserving retained utility under heterogeneous representation spaces and asymmetric update constraints. We propose SplitReAlign, a partition-aware representation realignment framework for class-wise SFU. It constructs endpoint-specific discriminative subspaces coordinated through a shared semantic anchor, selectively realigning forgotten representations while penalizing changes outside the active subspaces. To accommodate asymmetric update constraints, SplitReAlign leverages gradients through frozen servers for Client-only updates and fixed client-feature statistics for Server-only guidance, while Joint updates optimize both partitions. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 under heterogeneous client distributions demonstrate that SplitReAlign achieves the lowest average gap to retraining among all compared methods across six settings. Notably, Server-only achieves the closest agreement with retraining on both …

item.title: SoU-RHS: Bayesian Structured Sparsity for Compact Architecture Recovery in CNNs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

SoU-RHS：贝叶斯结构化稀疏恢复 CNN 紧凑架构

Highly parameterized convolutional neural networks often achieve strong predictive performance, but their memory, computation, and deployment costs motivate the search for methods that recover compact architectures from large reference models. We propose SoU-RHS, a Bayesian structured-sparsity procedure that augments Regularized Horseshoe Shrinkage (RHS) with the so-called Sources of Uncertainty Sparse Global-Local mechanism (SoU-SGL). The resulting model sharpens the separation between active and inactive filters, providing an effective mechanism for architecture recovery. A key property of SoU-RHS is stability: across different overparameterized starting widths and under a reasonable range of pruning thresholds, it recovers compact architectures with similar total size and layer-wise allocation. This supports the interpretation that the procedure is identifying a compact structure adapted to the data, rather than merely compressing each initial model separately. Across standard image-classification benchmarks, SoU-RHS recovers substantially smaller architectures than deterministic structured-sparsity baselines, while maintaining competitive accuracy, achieving lower negative log-…

item.title: Simpler Tiny Recursive Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

更简单的微型递归模型（TRM 变体）

Small models that execute deep looped computational graphs have shown great experimental results on puzzle-like problems like Sudoku, finding shortest paths through mazes, etc. The most well-known one is TRM (tiny recursive model), a simplification of HRM (hierarchical reasoning model). However, the underlying recursion is complicated and involves a high-level and a low-level state, a nested loop recursion, and the network calls with different input and output signatures depending on where we are in the loops. These mechanisms are needed to avoid memorization and overfitting. We propose STRM, a simplified design with a single state and a uniform update. STRM does not sacrifice generalization, improves training speed and final performance. Our key architectural choices that allow our simpler recursion to work are exponential moving updates on the states with varying rates that are jittered during training and readout of the solution on slow-updating channels only. We test STRM on Sudoku-Extreme, PPBench and Maze-Hard with the same data, parameters and compute as TRM: we improve over TRM by $3.8$ points on Sudoku-Extreme and $8.4$ points on PPBench and match it on Maze-Hard. On ARC-A…

item.title: Separating Interpretability and Reconstruction in Sparse Autoencoders
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

Separating Interpretability and Reconstruction in Sparse Autoencoders

Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are effective tools for mechanistic interpretability by decomposing neural representations into sparse and interpretable features. However, a single sparse representation in traditional SAEs is responsible for both reconstruction fidelity and interpretability, which are not guaranteed to align. To separate these objectives, we propose DualSAE, a modular framework that augments standard SAEs with a plug-in Residual Branch. A standard SAE serves as the Sparse Branch, learning a sparse code that contains the dominant semantics of the input. The added Residual Branch models the non-semantic information omitted by the Sparse Branch. We ensure that the contributions of the two branches towards the overall reconstruction have minimal overlap through a decorrelation loss. We also adopt a two-stage training strategy that first stabilizes sparse representation learning before coupling with the Residual Branch. Across diverse encoder-SAE configurations on two vision datasets and two language corpora, DualSAE achieves mean relative improvements of approximately 29% in reconstruction fidelity and 34% in interpretability (measured by monosemanticity score). item.title: ScaleBench: An Extensible and Reproducible Experimental Platform for Kubernetes Autoscaling Research
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

ScaleBench：可扩展可复现的 Kubernetes 自动扩缩容研究实验平台

Autoscaling enables cloud-native applications to meet their SLOs by dynamically adjusting computational resources at runtime. Recent research has explored a broad range of advanced autoscaling approaches, including rule-based, optimisation-based, and machine learning-based techniques, to address the limitations of traditional resource management strategies in cloud-native environments. Despite significant advances, a considerable gap remains between academic innovations and their practical adoption in real-world environments. For instance, Kubernetes deployments commonly rely on the reactive, CPU-based Horizontal Pod Autoscaler, limiting the adoption of more advanced autoscaling approaches. Recent studies have investigated challenges such as autoscaler configuration and reproducible performance evaluation; however, the practical deployment, integration complexity, and operational overhead of research-based autoscalers in Kubernetes environments have received limited attention. To address this gap, we present ScaleBench, a native Kubernetes experimental platform to enable extensible and reproducible evaluation of autoscaling solutions. item.title: Same Rank, Different Needs: Rethinking LoRA Redistribution in Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

联邦学习中 LoRA 重分配的 rank 预算再思考

Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables clients with different resource budgets to collaboratively fine-tune foundation models. To distribute an aggregated update within each client's rank budget, existing methods commonly retain its leading singular directions. However, directions that best reconstruct the update matrix need not best preserve its responses on a particular client's inputs: a lower-energy direction may matter more to that recipient. We formalize this mismatch and show that matrix-optimal truncation can incur arbitrarily larger response error than another readout of the same rank. Motivated by this result, we propose Receiver-Aware Subspace Adaptation (RASA), a plug-in framework for receiver-aware knowledge transfer. RASA uses compact diagonal input second moments to perform uncentered PCA of receiver-weighted update responses. The resulting readout is globally optimal for the rank-constrained receiver objective and preserves at least as much response energy as spectral truncation under the diagonal metric. item.title: Replay, Don't Resample: Off-Policy Consolidation of Long-Horizon RL Experts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

长程 RL 专家的 off-policy 巩固：重放而非重采样（替代 MOPD）

Frontier post-training follows a common recipe: train one expert per domain with reinforcement learning (RL), then consolidate the experts into one model via multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Such consolidation is expensive: the student samples in every environment again, an expert scores every sampled token, and the student inherits the drift of the final experts. Yet we argue that the experts' RL runs have already produced what consolidation needs: rollouts with their sampling probabilities and rewards, in the order the experts learned from them. We propose multi-expert replay policy distillation (MRPD), which replays these training logs through the student in the experts' order. At each step, the policy gradient is recomputed on these scored trajectories, and the final experts' distributions are distilled at the logged prefixes. Following the experts' own trajectory reduces the training-inference mismatch and keeps the student within the clip range, so the replay is off-policy in origin but quasi-on-policy throughout consolidation. item.title: Reliable arithmetic circuits using less reliable (sub-digital) logic
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF

用更不可靠的亚数字逻辑构造可靠算术电路：推翻超低电压静态失效壁垒

The frequent static failure of CMOS logic gates at ultra-low voltages has historically been perceived as a strict barrier to extreme voltage scaling: this paper introduces a statistical circuit law proving this intuition wrong. We discovered a universal power law connecting gate and circuit static failure probabilities, revealing that circuit failure requires the simultaneous breakdown of an entire gate cluster rather than a single component. Because the required cluster size increases rapidly as voltage drops, low-voltage \textit{sub-digital} logic exhibits surprising inherent resilience to static failure. This insight stems from new theoretical tools we developed to quantify static failure, extending well beyond conventional voltage-margin analysis. Consequently, sub-digital processors could potentially offer a viable, near-term solution to drastically reduce the energy demands of AI.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: ReCIM-HD: A 40 nm On-Device Learning Accelerator with Hyperdimensional Computing via Importance-Based Hybrid Digital-ReRAM CIM
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 端侧学习（ODL）加速器面临反向传播代价高、类超向量存储/推理能耗大、精度敏感子集易受模拟 CIM 误差影响等问题。

方法 ReCIM-HD 集成无梯度超维计算（HDC）+ ReRAM 模拟 CIM：ReRAM 非易失存储类超向量并做 CIM 相似度搜索，空闲可断电不丢数据；混合数字-模拟 CIM 推理流把精度关键小子集走数字保护；Kronecker HD 编码器降编码开销 + 定制 ISA。

关键数字 40nm 流片，44.17 TOPS/W（混合模式）、75.8 TOPS/W（ReRAM CIM 模式），能效最高比 SOTA 加速器高 20.1×。

为什么值得看 无反向传播的端侧学习 + ReRAM CIM，能效数据亮眼，类脑/HD 计算方向值得跟踪。

item.title: RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 agent 驱动的优化基准多聚焦单软件层（如 kernel），不清楚 agent 能否在生产负载下带来端到端性能提升。

方法 RSIBench-Infra 基准：20 个训练/推理任务、覆盖多模型家族与模态，最多 32 加速器的 NVIDIA GPU 与 Ascend NPU 部署；agent 从官方配方的可运行基线出发，可改 engine/kernel/指令层软件栈，OCI 镜像层提交协议保证可复现部署，独立评测端到端性能。

关键数字 全部任务结果中 66.2% 超过 1.10× 已验证加速。

为什么值得看 首个评估 agent 优化生产级训练/推理基础设施的基准，结论务实——agent 能提升，但端到端转化仍难。
